4.117.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇa keyaṃ janaiḥ sarvairviṣṭirbhadreti cocyate ..
kasyātmajeyaṃ kiṃrūpā pūjyate ca kathaṃ janaiḥ.....
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sutā mārtaṃḍadevasya chāyayā janitā purā ..
śanaiścarasya sodaryā bhaginyatibhayaṃkarī .. 2 ..
4.117.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कृष्ण केयं जनैः सर्वैर्विष्टिर्भद्रेति चोच्यते ॥
कस्यात्मजेयं किंरूपा पूज्यते च कथं जनैः॥॥॥। श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सुता मार्तंडदेवस्य छायया जनिता पुरा ॥
शनैश्चरस्य सोदर्या भगिन्यतिभयंकरी ॥ 2 ॥
4.117.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Kṛṣṇa, who is this one called Viṣṭi and Bhadrā by all people? / Whose daughter is she, what is her form, and how is she worshipped by people? / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, she was born as the daughter of the god Mārtaṇḍa through Chāyā, / the uterine sister of Śanaiścara, a most terrifying sister.

4.117.s:
sā jātamātrā bhuvanaṃ grastuṃ samupacakrame ..
kṛṣṇā karālavadanā sitadaṃṣṭrordhvamūrddhajā .. 3 ..
4.117.d:
सा जातमात्रा भुवनं ग्रस्तुं समुपचक्रमे ॥
कृष्णा करालवदना सितदंष्ट्रोर्ध्वमूर्द्धजा ॥ 3 ॥
4.117.m: As soon as she was born, she set about devouring the world, / dark, with a gaping mouth, white fangs, and hair bristling upright.

4.117.s:
niryāti yadi kāryeṇa kaścittasya puraḥ sthitā ..
vighnaṃ karoti svapato bhuñjānasya sthitasya vā .. 4 ..
4.117.d:
निर्याति यदि कार्येण कश्चित्तस्य पुरः स्थिता ॥
विघ्नं करोति स्वपतो भुञ्जानस्य स्थितस्य वा ॥ 4 ॥
4.117.m: If anyone went forth on business, she stood before him; / she created an obstacle whether he was sleeping, eating, or standing.

4.117.s:
yajñavighnakarī raudrā samājotsavanāśinī ..
nityodvegakarī raudrā vināśayati sā jagat .. 5 ..
4.117.d:
यज्ञविघ्नकरी रौद्रा समाजोत्सवनाशिनी ॥
नित्योद्वेगकरी रौद्रा विनाशयति सा जगत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.117.m: She was a creator of obstacles to sacrifices, ferocious, a destroyer of public assemblies and festivals, / constantly causing distress, ferocious, she destroyed the world.

4.117.s:
tāṃ tu durvinayāsaktāṃ dṛṣṭvā devo divākaraḥ ..
ciṃtayāmāsa kasyāpi yacchāmyenāṃ sumadhyamām .. 6..
4.117.d:
तां तु दुर्विनयासक्तां दृष्ट्वा देवो दिवाकरः ॥
चिंतयामास कस्यापि यच्छाम्येनां सुमध्यमाम् ॥ 6॥
4.117.m: Seeing her addicted to insolence, the god Divākara / wondered: 'To whom should I give this slender-waisted maiden?'

4.117.s:
kanyādurvinayācceha pitā doṣeṇa gṛhyate ..
yuvatyāstu tato bhartā tasmādbhartṛgṛhaṃ nayet ..7..
4.117.d:
कन्यादुर्विनयाच्चेह पिता दोषेण गृह्यते ॥
युवत्यास्तु ततो भर्ता तस्माद्भर्तृगृहं नयेत् ॥7॥
4.117.m: For in this world a father is tainted with fault due to the misbehaviour of an unmarried daughter; / but [in the case] of a young married woman, her husband [is held accountable]; therefore one should convey her to a husband's house.

4.117.s:
viciṃtyaivaṃ sutāṃ bhadrāṃ yasyayasya prayacchati ..
te namaṃti kṣaṇenaiva surarākṣasakinnarāḥ .. 8 ..
4.117.d:
विचिंत्यैवं सुतां भद्रां यस्ययस्य प्रयच्छति ॥
ते नमंति क्षणेनैव सुरराक्षसकिन्नराः ॥ 8 ॥
4.117.m: Reflecting thus, whomever he offered his daughter Bhadrā to, / those gods, rākṣasas, and kinnaras bowed down instantly [in refusal].

4.117.s:
maṇḍapaṃ maṇḍapārambhe bhaṃktvā bhīṣayate janam ..
vivasvāṃścintayāviṣṭaḥ kasyeyaṃ pratipādyatām .. 9 ..
4.117.d:
मण्डपं मण्डपारम्भे भंक्त्वा भीषयते जनम् ॥
विवस्वांश्चिन्तयाविष्टः कस्येयं प्रतिपाद्यताम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.117.m: Breaking the pavilion at the beginning of the pavilion-rite, she terrified the people. / Vivasvat was filled with anxiety: 'To whom should she be given?'

4.117.s:
virūpā duṣṭahṛdayā svecchācāravihāriṇī ..
dattāpyeṣā na doṣāya bhavatīha kathaṃcana ..4.117.1 0..
4.117.d:
विरूपा दुष्टहृदया स्वेच्छाचारविहारिणी ॥
दत्ताप्येषा न दोषाय भवतीह कथंचन ॥4.117.1 0॥
4.117.m: Deformed, evil-hearted, roaming about at her own whim, / even if given away, may she never bring blame here in any way.

4.117.s:
vitarkayanyāvadevamāste devo divaspatiḥ ..
tāvattayā jagatsarvaṃ duṣṭayā samabhidrutam .. 11 ..
4.117.d:
वितर्कयन्यावदेवमास्ते देवो दिवस्पतिः ॥
तावत्तया जगत्सर्वं दुष्टया समभिद्रुतम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.117.m: While the god Divaspati sat deliberating thus, / meanwhile the entire world was overrun by that wicked one.

4.117.s:
athājagāma savituḥ pārśve brahmā'ṇḍasaṃbhavaḥ ..
kāryaṃ nivedayāmāsa viṣṭerdauṣṭyamaśeṣataḥ .. 12 ..
4.117.d:
अथाजगाम सवितुः पार्श्वे ब्रह्माऽण्डसंभवः ॥
कार्यं निवेदयामास विष्टेर्दौष्ट्यमशेषतः ॥ 12 ॥
4.117.m: Then Brahmā, who was born from the cosmic egg, came to the side of Savitṛ; / he announced the matter, the complete villainy of Viṣṭi.

4.117.s:
bhāskarastamuvācātha brahmāṇaṃ bhuvaneśvaram ..
bhavānkartā ca hartā ca kasmādevaṃ prabhāṣase .. 13 ..
4.117.d:
भास्करस्तमुवाचाथ ब्रह्माणं भुवनेश्वरम् ॥
भवान्कर्ता च हर्ता च कस्मादेवं प्रभाषसे ॥ 13 ॥
4.117.m: Bhāskara then said to that Brahmā, the lord of the worlds: / 'You are the creator and the destroyer; why do you speak thus?'

4.117.s:
evamuktastadā brahmā bhāskareṇāmitadyutiḥ ..
uvāca viṣṭimānāyya śṛṣu bhadre mayoditum .. 14 ..
4.117.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मा भास्करेणामितद्युतिः ॥
उवाच विष्टिमानाय्य शृषु भद्रे मयोदितुम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.117.m: Being thus addressed by Bhāskara, Brahmā of boundless splendour / summoned Viṣṭi and spoke: 'Listen, auspicious one, to what is said by me.'

4.117.s:
karaṇaiḥ saha vartasva bavabālavakaulavaiḥ ..
saptame'rdhadine prāpte yadabhīṣṭaṃ kuruṣva tat .. 15 ..
4.117.d:
करणैः सह वर्तस्व बवबालवकौलवैः ॥
सप्तमेऽर्धदिने प्राप्ते यदभीष्टं कुरुष्व तत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.117.m: 'Dwell together with the astrological divisions—Bava, Bālava, and Kaulava. / When the seventh half-day has arrived, do whatever is your desire.'

4.117.s:
yātrāpraveśamāṃgalyakṛṣivāṇijyakāraṇāt ..
bhakṣayasvābhimukhagānnarānunmārgagāminaḥ.. .. 16 ..
4.117.d:
यात्राप्रवेशमांगल्यकृषिवाणिज्यकारणात् ॥
भक्षयस्वाभिमुखगान्नरानुन्मार्गगामिनः॥ ॥ 16 ॥
4.117.m: 'For reasons of journeys, entries, auspicious events, agriculture, and commerce, / devour those men who go straight ahead, who wander off the proper path.'

4.117.s:
udvejanīyo no hi jano bhavatyā divasatrayam ..
pūjyā surāsurāṇāṃ tvaṃ divasārddhe bhaviṣyasi .. 17 ..
4.117.d:
उद्वेजनीयो नो हि जनो भवत्या दिवसत्रयम् ॥
पूज्या सुरासुराणां त्वं दिवसार्द्धे भविष्यसि ॥ 17 ॥
4.117.m: 'Indeed, no people should be distressed by you for three days; / you shall be worshipped by gods and asuras for half a day.'

4.117.s:
ullaṃghya ye pravartaṃte bhadre tvāṃ nirbhayā narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ vināśayāśu tvaṃ kāryamārye sukhī bhava .. 18 ..
4.117.d:
उल्लंघ्य ये प्रवर्तंते भद्रे त्वां निर्भया नराः ॥
तेषां विनाशयाशु त्वं कार्यमार्ये सुखी भव ॥ 18 ॥
4.117.m: 'Those men who act fearlessly, having transgressed you, O Bhadrā, / quickly destroy their work, noble lady; be happy!'

4.117.s:
evamuktvā gato brahmā bhadrāpi bhuvanatrayam ..
babhrāmodbhrāṃtahṛdayā bhīṣayantī surāsurān .. 19 ..
4.117.d:
एवमुक्त्वा गतो ब्रह्मा भद्रापि भुवनत्रयम् ॥
बभ्रामोद्भ्रांतहृदया भीषयन्ती सुरासुरान् ॥ 19 ॥
4.117.m: Having spoken thus, Brahmā departed, and Bhadrā too / wandered the three worlds with an agitated heart, terrifying gods and asuras.

4.117.s:
evameṣā samutpannā viṣṭiriṣṭavināśinī ..
niveditā te kauṃteya tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet .. 4.117.20 ..
4.117.d:
एवमेषा समुत्पन्ना विष्टिरिष्टविनाशिनी ॥
निवेदिता ते कौंतेय तस्मात्तां परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 4.117.20 ॥
4.117.m: Thus this Viṣṭi arose, a destroyer of desired outcomes; / she has been described to you, O son of Kuntī, therefore one must avoid her.

4.117.s:
asitajaladavarṇā dīrghanāsogradaṃṣṭrā vipulahanukapālā piṃḍikodbaddhajaṃghā ..
analaśatasahasraṃ codgiraṃtī samaṃtātpatati bhuvanamadhye kāryanāśāya viṣṭiḥ .. 21 ..
4.117.d:
असितजलदवर्णा दीर्घनासोग्रदंष्ट्रा विपुलहनुकपाला पिंडिकोद्बद्धजंघा ॥
अनलशतसहस्रं चोद्गिरंती समंतात्पतति भुवनमध्ये कार्यनाशाय विष्टिः ॥ 21 ॥
4.117.m: Dark as a rain-cloud, with a long nose and ferocious fangs, broad jaws and cheekbones, calves tight with bulging muscles, / and spewing forth hundreds of thousands of flames on all sides, Viṣṭi descends into the midst of the world for the destruction of actions.

4.117.s:
bhānoḥ sutā ketuśatāgrajātā kṛṣṇā kumūrtiḥ satataṃ kucelā ..
devairniyuktā karaṇārthasaṃsthā viṣṭistu sarvatra vivarjanīyā .. 22 ..
4.117.d:
भानोः सुता केतुशताग्रजाता कृष्णा कुमूर्तिः सततं कुचेला ॥
देवैर्नियुक्ता करणार्थसंस्था विष्टिस्तु सर्वत्र विवर्जनीया ॥ 22 ॥
4.117.m: Daughter of the sun, elder-born of a hundred Ketus, dark, ill-formed, constantly wearing filthy garments, / appointed by the gods, situated in the sphere of the astrological divisions, Viṣṭi must be avoided everywhere.

4.117.s:
mukhe tu ghaṭikāḥ pañca dve kaṃṭhe tu sadā sthite ..
hṛdi caikādaśa proktāścatasro nābhimaṃḍale .. 23 ..
4.117.d:
मुखे तु घटिकाः पञ्च द्वे कंठे तु सदा स्थिते ॥
हृदि चैकादश प्रोक्ताश्चतस्रो नाभिमंडले ॥ 23 ॥
4.117.m: Five ghaṭikās are situated in her mouth, and two are always in her throat; / eleven are declared in her heart, and four in the region of the navel.

4.117.s:
kaṭyāṃ pañcaiva vijñeyāstisraḥ pucche jayāvahāḥ ..
mukhe kāryavināśāya grīvāyāṃ dhananāśinī.. 24 ..
4.117.d:
कट्यां पञ्चैव विज्ञेयास्तिस्रः पुच्छे जयावहाः ॥
मुखे कार्यविनाशाय ग्रीवायां धननाशिनी॥ 24 ॥
4.117.m: Five are to be known in her waist, and three in her tail, bringing victory. / In the mouth, she causes destruction of undertakings; in the neck, she destroys wealth.

4.117.s:
hadi prāṇaharā jñeyā nābhyāṃ tu kalahāvahā ..
kaṭyāmarthaparibhraṃśo viṣṭipucche dhruvo jayaḥ ..25..
4.117.d:
हदि प्राणहरा ज्ञेया नाभ्यां तु कलहावहा ॥
कट्यामर्थपरिभ्रंशो विष्टिपुच्छे ध्रुवो जयः ॥25॥
4.117.m: In the heart she is known to take away life, but in the navel she brings quarrel; / in the waist there is loss of wealth, [but] in the tail of Viṣṭi, victory is certain.

4.117.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāryāṇi suśubhānyaśubhāni ca ..
tāni sarvāṇi siddhyaṃti viṣṭipucche na saṃśayaḥ ..26 ..
4.117.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि कार्याणि सुशुभान्यशुभानि च ॥
तानि सर्वाणि सिद्ध्यंति विष्टिपुच्छे न संशयः ॥26 ॥
4.117.m: Whatever undertakings there are on earth, whether very auspicious or inauspicious, / all of them succeed during the tail of Viṣṭi, without a doubt.

4.117.s:
dhanyā dadhimukhī bhadrā mahāmārī kharānanā ..
kālarātrirmahārudrā viṣṭiśca kulaputrikā .. 27 ..
4.117.d:
धन्या दधिमुखी भद्रा महामारी खरानना ॥
कालरात्रिर्महारुद्रा विष्टिश्च कुलपुत्रिका ॥ 27 ॥
4.117.m: Dhanyā, Dadhimukhī, Bhadrā, Mahāmārī, Kharānanā, / Kālarātri, Mahārudrā, and Viṣṭi, Kulaputrikā,

4.117.s:
bhairavī ca mahākālī asurāṇāṃ kṣayaṃkarī ..
dvādaśaiva tu nāmāni prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭheta .. 28 ..
4.117.d:
भैरवी च महाकाली असुराणां क्षयंकरी ॥
द्वादशैव तु नामानि प्रातरुत्थाय यः पठेत ॥ 28 ॥
4.117.m: Bhairavī, and Mahākālī, the destroyer of asuras— / whoever recites these twelve names upon rising in the morning,

4.117.s:
na ca vyādhirbhavettasya rogī rogātpramucyate ..
grahāḥ sarve'nukūlāḥ syurna ca vighnādi jāyate .. 29 ..
4.117.d:
न च व्याधिर्भवेत्तस्य रोगी रोगात्प्रमुच्यते ॥
ग्रहाः सर्वेऽनुकूलाः स्युर्न च विघ्नादि जायते ॥ 29 ॥
4.117.m: No illness will afflict him; an invalid is freed from disease; / all planets will be favorable, and no obstacle and the like arises.

4.117.s: raṇe rājakule dyūte sarvatra vijayī bhavet ..4.117.30 ..
4.117.d: रणे राजकुले द्यूते सर्वत्र विजयी भवेत् ॥4.117.30 ॥
4.117.m: In battle, in the royal court, and in gambling, he will be victorious everywhere.

4.117.s:
yaśca pūjayate nityaṃ śāstroktavidhinā naraḥ ..
tasya sarvārthasiddhistu bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ .. 31 ..
4.117.d:
यश्च पूजयते नित्यं शास्त्रोक्तविधिना नरः ॥
तस्य सर्वार्थसिद्धिस्तु भवतीह न संशयः ॥ 31 ॥
4.117.m: And the man who constantly worships [her] according to the rule declared in the scriptures, / achieves success in all purposes here [in this world], without a doubt.

4.117.s:
yenopavāsavidhinā vratena ca yaśasvinī ..
pūjitā tuṣṭimabhyeti tadeva kathayāmi te .. 32..
4.117.d:
येनोपवासविधिना व्रतेन च यशस्विनी ॥
पूजिता तुष्टिमभ्येति तदेव कथयामि ते ॥ 32॥
4.117.m: I will explain to you that very rule of fasting and votive observance / by which, when worshipped, the illustrious one attains satisfaction.

4.117.s:
yasmindine bhavedbhadrā tasminnahani bhārata ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryā nnārī naro'tha vā .. 3..
4.117.d:
यस्मिन्दिने भवेद्भद्रा तस्मिन्नहनि भारत ॥
उपवासस्य नियमं कुर्या न्नारी नरोऽथ वा ॥ 3॥
4.117.m: On whichever day Bhadrā occurs, on that day, O Bhārata, / a woman or a man should make the vow of fasting.

4.117.s:
yadi rātrau bhavedviṣṭirekabhuktaṃ dinadvayam ..
kāryaṃ tenopavāsaḥ syāditi paurāṇikī śrutiḥ .. 34 ..
4.117.d:
यदि रात्रौ भवेद्विष्टिरेकभुक्तं दिनद्वयम् ॥
कार्यं तेनोपवासः स्यादिति पौराणिकी श्रुतिः ॥ 34 ॥
4.117.m: If Viṣṭi should occur at night, eating a single meal on both days / should be done, [and] thereby there will be a fast; such is the purāṇic scriptural teaching.

4.117.s:
praharasyopari yadā syādviṣṭiḥ praharatrayam ..
tatropavāsaḥ kartavya ekabhuktamatonyathā.. 35 ..
4.117.d:
प्रहरस्योपरि यदा स्याद्विष्टिः प्रहरत्रयम् ॥
तत्रोपवासः कर्तव्य एकभुक्तमतोन्यथा॥ 35 ॥
4.117.m: When Viṣṭi occurs for three praharas beyond one prahara, / then a fast must be observed; otherwise, eating a single meal [is prescribed].

4.117.s:
sarvauṣadhyudakasnānaṃ sugaṃdhāmalakairatha ..
nadyāṃ taḍāge'tha gṛhe snānaṃ sarvatra śasyate .. 36 ..
4.117.d:
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नानं सुगंधामलकैरथ ॥
नद्यां तडागेऽथ गृहे स्नानं सर्वत्र शस्यते ॥ 36 ॥
4.117.m: Bathing with water infused with all medicinal herbs and with fragrant myrobalans / in a river, in a pond, or at home—bathing everywhere is commended.

4.117.s:
devānpitṝnprīṇayitvā tato darbhamayīṃ śubhām ..
viṣṭiṃ kṛtvā puṣpadhūpairnaivedyena ca pūjayet .. 37 ..
4.117.d:
देवान्पितॄन्प्रीणयित्वा ततो दर्भमयीं शुभाम् ॥
विष्टिं कृत्वा पुष्पधूपैर्नैवेद्येन च पूजयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.117.m: Having gratified the gods and the ancestors, one should then make an auspicious [image of] Viṣṭi / made of darbha-grass and worship her with flowers, incenses, and food-offerings.

4.117.s:
homaṃ kṛtvā viṣṭināmairaṣṭottaraśataṃ tataḥ ..
bhuñjīta dattvā viprāya tilānpāyasameva ca ..
satilāṃ kṛśarāṃ bhuktvā paścādbhuñjīta kāmataḥ.. 38..
4.117.d:
होमं कृत्वा विष्टिनामैरष्टोत्तरशतं ततः ॥
भुञ्जीत दत्त्वा विप्राय तिलान्पायसमेव च ॥
सतिलां कृशरां भुक्त्वा पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत कामतः॥ 38॥
4.117.m: Having performed a fire sacrifice with the names of Viṣṭi one hundred and eight times, / one should eat after giving sesame seeds and rice boiled with milk to a brāhmaṇa; / having eaten rice and lentils cooked with sesame, he may subsequently eat at will.

4.117.s:
chāyāsūryasute devi viṣṭiriṣṭārthadāyini ..
pūjitā'si yathāśaktyā bhadre bhadrapradā bhava .. 39 ..
4.117.d:
छायासूर्यसुते देवि विष्टिरिष्टार्थदायिनि ॥
पूजिताऽसि यथाशक्त्या भद्रे भद्रप्रदा भव ॥ 39 ॥
4.117.m: 'O goddess, daughter of Chāyā and Sūrya, O Viṣṭi who grants desired objects, / you have been worshipped according to my capacity; O Bhadrā, be the granter of auspiciousness!'

4.117.s:
upoṣpa vidhinānena daśa sapta yathākramam ..
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryātpūrvava tpūjya bhāminīm .. 4.117.40 ..
4.117.d:
उपोष्प विधिनानेन दश सप्त यथाक्रमम् ॥
उद्यापनं ततः कुर्यात्पूर्वव त्पूज्य भामिनीम् ॥ 4.117.40 ॥
4.117.m: Having fasted according to this rule for ten and seven [times] in succession, / one should then perform the concluding rite, having worshipped the lady as before.

4.117.s:
sthāpayitvāyase pīṭhe kṛśarānnaṃ nivedya ca ..
paridhāpya kṛṣṇayugaṃ stutvā maṃtreṇa tāṃ punaḥ .. 41 ..
4.117.d:
स्थापयित्वायसे पीठे कृशरान्नं निवेद्य च ॥
परिधाप्य कृष्णयुगं स्तुत्वा मंत्रेण तां पुनः ॥ 41 ॥
4.117.m:
Having placed [her] on an iron pedestal and offered rice cooked with sesame,
having clothed [her] in a pair of black garments and praised her again with the mantra,

4.117.s:
brāhmaṇāya punardadyāllohaṃ tailaṃ tilāṃstathā ..
kṛṣṇāṃ savatsāṃ gāmekāṃ tathaikaṃ kālakaṃbalam ..
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā dattvā bhadrāṃ visarjayet .. 42 ..
4.117.d:
ब्राह्मणाय पुनर्दद्याल्लोहं तैलं तिलांस्तथा ॥
कृष्णां सवत्सां गामेकां तथैकं कालकंबलम् ॥
दक्षिणां च यथाशक्त्या दत्त्वा भद्रां विसर्जयेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.117.m:
one should then give to a brāhmaṇa iron, oil, and sesame seeds,
one black cow together with its calf, and one black blanket.
Having given the sacrificial fee according to one's means, one should dismiss Bhadrā.

4.117.s:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha samyagbhadrāvrataṃ naraḥ ..
vighno na jāyate tasya kāryāraṃbhe kadācana .. 43 ..
4.117.d:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ सम्यग्भद्राव्रतं नरः ॥
विघ्नो न जायते तस्य कार्यारंभे कदाचन ॥ 43 ॥
4.117.m:
A man who thus correctly performs the Bhadrāvrata, O son of Pṛthā,
no obstacle arises for him at the undertaking of any task at any time.

4.117.s:
rākṣasāśca piśācā vā pūtanāśākinīgrahāḥ ..
na pīḍayanti taṃ martyaṃ yo bhadrāvratamācaret .. 44 ..
4.117.d:
राक्षसाश्च पिशाचा वा पूतनाशाकिनीग्रहाः ॥
न पीडयन्ति तं मर्त्यं यो भद्राव्रतमाचरेत् ॥ 44 ॥
4.117.m:
Neither rākṣasas, nor piśācas, nor pūtanās, śākinīs, or seizing spirits
afflict that mortal who performs the Bhadrāvrata.

4.117.s:
na caiveṣṭaviyogaḥ syānna hānistasya jāyate ..
dehāṃte yāti sadanaṃ bhāskarasya na saṃśayaḥ .. 45 ..
4.117.d:
न चैवेष्टवियोगः स्यान्न हानिस्तस्य जायते ॥
देहांते याति सदनं भास्करस्य न संशयः ॥ 45 ॥
4.117.m:
He suffers no separation from what is dear, nor does loss occur to him.
At the end of his body, he goes to the abode of the sun; there is no doubt.

4.117.s:
sūryātmajātidayitā bhaginī śaneryā martye bhramatyatirathā karaṇakrameṇa ..
tāṃ kṛṣṇabhāsuramukhīṃ samupoṣya viṣṭimiṣṭārthasiddhimabudho'pi pumānupaiti.. 46..
agastyavratavarṇanam
4.117.d:
सूर्यात्मजातिदयिता भगिनी शनेर्या मर्त्ये भ्रमत्यतिरथा करणक्रमेण ॥
तां कृष्णभासुरमुखीं समुपोष्य विष्टिमिष्टार्थसिद्धिमबुधोऽपि पुमानुपैति॥ 46॥
अगस्त्यव्रतवर्णनम्
4.117.m:
The daughter of the sun, exceedingly beloved, the sister of Śani, who wanders among mortals swiftly according to the order of the astrological divisions,
having fasted for her, Viṣṭi, whose face shines black, even an ignorant man attains the success of his desired goals.
Description of the Agastyavrata.

4.118.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
agastyavratamastyanyatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
tacchṛṇuṣva mahīpāla kathyamānaṃ mayānagha .. 1 ..
4.118.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अगस्त्यव्रतमस्त्यन्यत्सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
तच्छृणुष्व महीपाल कथ्यमानं मयानघ ॥ 1 ॥
4.118.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
There is another vow, the Agastyavrata, which destroys all sins.
Listen to it being spoken by me, O sinless lord of the earth.

4.118.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śṛṇomi brūhi me kṛṣṇa devarṣestasya ceṣṭitam ..
janma caivārghadānaṃ ca kālamudgamanasya ca ..2..
4.118.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणोमि ब्रूहि मे कृष्ण देवर्षेस्तस्य चेष्टितम् ॥
जन्म चैवार्घदानं च कालमुद्गमनस्य च ॥2॥
4.118.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
I am listening; tell me, O Kṛṣṇa, the deeds of that divine sage,
his birth, the offering of water-oblations [to him], and the time of his rising.

4.118.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mitraśca varuṇaścaiva pūrvametau surottamau ..
maṃdarasya samīpe tu ceraturvipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 3 ..
4.118.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
मित्रश्च वरुणश्चैव पूर्वमेतौ सुरोत्तमौ ॥
मंदरस्य समीपे तु चेरतुर्विपुलं तपः ॥ 3 ॥
4.118.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, those two best of gods, Mitra and Varuṇa,
performed severe austerities near Mount Mandara.

4.118.s:
tayoḥ saṃkṣobhaṇārthāya vāsavena varāpsarāḥ ..
urvaśī preṣitā tatra rūpodāryaguṇānvitā .. 4 ..
4.118.d:
तयोः संक्षोभणार्थाय वासवेन वराप्सराः ॥
उर्वशी प्रेषिता तत्र रूपोदार्यगुणान्विता ॥ 4 ॥
4.118.m:
In order to disturb them, the supreme apsaras Urvaśī,
endowed with beauty, majesty, and [good] qualities, was sent there by Indra.

4.118.s:
tasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva kṣubhitau tau surottamau ..
vikāraṃ manaso buddhvā kuṃbhe vīryaṃ sasarjatuḥ .. 5 ..
4.118.d:
तस्याः संदर्शनादेव क्षुभितौ तौ सुरोत्तमौ ॥
विकारं मनसो बुद्ध्वा कुंभे वीर्यं ससर्जतुः ॥ 5 ॥
4.118.m:
At the very sight of her, those two best of gods were agitated.
Recognising the perturbation of their minds, they discharged their semen into a water jar.

4.118.s:
nimeḥ śāpāttatra jāto vaśiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ ..
anaṃtaramagastyastu jāto divyastapodhanaḥ .. 6 ..
4.118.d:
निमेः शापात्तत्र जातो वशिष्ठो भगवानृषिः ॥
अनंतरमगस्त्यस्तु जातो दिव्यस्तपोधनः ॥ 6 ॥
4.118.m:
From that [jar], on account of the curse of Nimi, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha was born,
and immediately thereafter was born Agastya, rich in divine austerity.

4.118.s:
malayasyaikadeśe tu vaikhānasavidhānataḥ ..
sabhāryaḥ saṃvṛto vipraistapastepe suduścaram .. 7 ..
4.118.d:
मलयस्यैकदेशे तु वैखानसविधानतः ॥
सभार्यः संवृतो विप्रैस्तपस्तेपे सुदुश्चरम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.118.m:
In a region of Mount Malaya, according to the Vaikhānasa rule,
accompanied by his wife and surrounded by brāhmaṇas, he performed austerity exceedingly difficult to practice.

4.118.s:
āstāṃ daityau purā duṣṭāvādau kṛtayugasya tu ..
nāmnā ilvalavātāpī devabrāhmaṇakaṃṭakau .. 8 ..
4.118.d:
आस्तां दैत्यौ पुरा दुष्टावादौ कृतयुगस्य तु ॥
नाम्ना इल्वलवातापी देवब्राह्मणकंटकौ ॥ 8 ॥
4.118.m:
In ancient times, at the beginning of the Kṛtayuga, there were two wicked daityas
named Ilvala and Vātāpi, thorns in the side of gods and brāhmaṇas.

4.118.s:
tayoreko'bhavanmeṣo dvitīyo bhojyadāyakaḥ ..
śrāddhakrameṇa tenaivaṃ bahavo nāśitā dvijāḥ .. 9 ..
4.118.d:
तयोरेकोऽभवन्मेषो द्वितीयो भोज्यदायकः ॥
श्राद्धक्रमेण तेनैवं बहवो नाशिता द्विजाः ॥ 9 ॥
4.118.m:
One of the two would become a ram, and the second was the giver of food.
In this way, under the pretext of funeral rites, many twice-born were destroyed by him.

4.118.s:
athānyasmindine daityo hyagastyaṃ saṃnyamantrayat ..
bhojyārthaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhṛgugargakulodbhavaiḥ .. 4.118.10 ..
4.118.d:
अथान्यस्मिन्दिने दैत्यो ह्यगस्त्यं संन्यमन्त्रयत् ॥
भोज्यार्थं ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं भृगुगर्गकुलोद्भवैः ॥ 4.118.10 ॥
4.118.m:
Then, on another day, the daitya invited Agastya
for food, together with brāhmaṇas born of the lineages of Bhṛgu and Garga.

4.118.s:
agastyopyabhavacchrāddhe dhaureyo roṣadarpitaḥ ..
so'pi hatvāpacadvahnau vātāpiṃ meṣarūpiṇam .. 11 ..
4.118.d:
अगस्त्योप्यभवच्छ्राद्धे धौरेयो रोषदर्पितः ॥
सोऽपि हत्वापचद्वह्नौ वातापिं मेषरूपिणम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.118.m:
Agastya also, proud in his wrath, became the foremost [guest] at the funeral rite;
and he [Ilvala], having slaughtered Vātāpi who had assumed the form of a ram, cooked [him] in the fire.

4.118.s:
pariviṣyamāṇeṣu teṣu stimitaṃ prāha dānavam ..
agastyo bhagavānkruddhaḥ sarvaṃ me dīyatāmiti .. 12 ..
4.118.d:
परिविष्यमाणेषु तेषु स्तिमितं प्राह दानवम् ॥
अगस्त्यो भगवान्क्रुद्धः सर्वं मे दीयतामिति ॥ 12 ॥
4.118.m:
While they were being served, the venerable Agastya, enraged,
said quietly to the dānava: 'Let everything be given to me.'

4.118.s:
maiṣaṃ māṃsaṃ tataḥ prādādilvalaḥ kupitastadā ..
bhakṣayitvā'bhavatsvastho nirvikāro mahāmuniḥ .. 13 ..
4.118.d:
मैषं मांसं ततः प्रादादिल्वलः कुपितस्तदा ॥
भक्षयित्वाऽभवत्स्वस्थो निर्विकारो महामुनिः ॥ 13 ॥
4.118.m:
Then the angered Ilvala gave him the meat of the ram.
Having consumed it, the great sage remained at ease and untroubled.

4.118.s:
śucirbabhau tataḥ prāha vātāpimilvalaḥ śanaiḥ ..
niṣkramasva munerddehaṃ bhittvā kasmādvilaṃbase .. 14 ..
4.118.d:
शुचिर्बभौ ततः प्राह वातापिमिल्वलः शनैः ॥
निष्क्रमस्व मुनेर्द्देहं भित्त्वा कस्माद्विलंबसे ॥ 14 ॥
4.118.m:
He shone radiant and pure. Then Ilvala said softly to Vātāpi:
'Bursting open the body of the sage, come out! Why do you delay?'

4.118.s:
tacchrutvāgastyavipro'pi udgāraṃ kṛtavāngurum ..
kuto niṣkramaṇaṃ prāha bhakṣitaḥ sa mayā punaḥ .. 15 ..
4.118.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वागस्त्यविप्रोऽपि उद्गारं कृतवान्गुरुम् ॥
कुतो निष्क्रमणं प्राह भक्षितः स मया पुनः ॥ 15 ॥
4.118.m:
Hearing that, the brāhmaṇa Agastya let out a mighty belch
and said: 'Whence can he come out? He has been consumed by me.'

4.118.s:
jīrṇo'yaṃ bhasmabhūto'yaṃ vātāpirbrahmakaṃṭakaḥ ..
ilvalo'pi sphuratkrodhaḥ so'gastyena nirīkṣitaḥ .. 16 ..
4.118.d:
जीर्णोऽयं भस्मभूतोऽयं वातापिर्ब्रह्मकंटकः ॥
इल्वलोऽपि स्फुरत्क्रोधः सोऽगस्त्येन निरीक्षितः ॥ 16 ॥
4.118.m:
Digested is he, turned to ashes is he, Vātāpi, the thorn in the side of brāhmaṇas.
Then Ilvala, quivering with rage, was looked upon by Agastya;

4.118.s:
bhasmībhūtaḥ kṣaṇenaiva tataḥ śāṃtaṃ jagadbabhau ..
tena vaireṇa te duṣṭā naṣṭaśeṣāstu dānavāḥ .. 17 ..
4.118.d:
भस्मीभूतः क्षणेनैव ततः शांतं जगद्बभौ ॥
तेन वैरेण ते दुष्टा नष्टशेषास्तु दानवाः ॥ 17 ॥
4.118.m:
in an instant he was reduced to ashes, and then the world shone peaceful.
Out of that enmity, those wicked dānavas who remained after the destruction,

4.118.s:
saṃmaṃtrya niścayaṃ merau tato'gastyamupāgatāḥ ..
vivarddhayiṣavastejo munerasya divaukasaḥ .. 18 ..
4.118.d:
संमंत्र्य निश्चयं मेरौ ततोऽगस्त्यमुपागताः ॥
विवर्द्धयिषवस्तेजो मुनेरस्य दिवौकसः ॥ 18 ॥
4.118.m:
having conferred and made a resolution on Mount Meru, then approached Agastya.
Desiring to increase the splendour of this sage, the denizens of heaven

4.118.s:
te'gastyamāhurbrahmarṣe samudraṃ śoṣayasva vai ..
tacchrutvāgastyavipro'pi āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dadhat .. 19 ..
4.118.d:
तेऽगस्त्यमाहुर्ब्रह्मर्षे समुद्रं शोषयस्व वै ॥
तच्छ्रुत्वागस्त्यविप्रोऽपि आग्नेयीं धारणां दधत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.118.m:
said to Agastya: 'O divine sage, dry up the ocean!'
Hearing that, the brāhmaṇa Agastya, holding the fiery contemplation,

4.118.s:
tayā pītaḥ samudro'pi bhrāṃtamīnormikacchapaḥ ..
pīte samudratoye'pi devaiḥ kruddhaistu dānavāḥ .. 4.118.20 ..
4.118.d:
तया पीतः समुद्रोऽपि भ्रांतमीनोर्मिकच्छपः ॥
पीते समुद्रतोयेऽपि देवैः क्रुद्धैस्तु दानवाः ॥ 4.118.20 ॥
4.118.m:
by means of it drank even the ocean, with its churning fish, waves, and turtles.
When the water of the ocean was drunk up, the dānavas by the enraged gods

4.118.s:
kṣayaṃ nītāḥ kṣaṇātsarve krandamānāḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
kṣemaṃ jagatyabhūtsarvamagastyarṣeḥ prasādataḥ ..21..
4.118.d:
क्षयं नीताः क्षणात्सर्वे क्रन्दमानाः पुनःपुनः ॥
क्षेमं जगत्यभूत्सर्वमगस्त्यर्षेः प्रसादतः ॥21॥
4.118.m:
were brought to destruction in an instant, crying out again and again.
Complete security arose in the world by the grace of the sage Agastya.

4.118.s:
atha gaṃgānadītoyaiḥ saṃpūrṇe sāgare punaḥ ..
maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim .. 22 ..
4.118.d:
अथ गंगानदीतोयैः संपूर्णे सागरे पुनः ॥
मंथानं मंदरं कृत्वा नेत्रं कृत्वा तु वासुकिम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.118.m:
Then, when the ocean was filled again with the waters of the river Gaṅgā,
having made Mount Mandara the churning rod and Vāsuki the rope,

4.118.s:
mamaṃthuḥ sahitāḥ sarve samudraṃ daityadānavāḥ ..
athotthitaṃ ratnasaṃghe some śrīkaustubhe gaje .. 23 ..
4.118.d:
ममंथुः सहिताः सर्वे समुद्रं दैत्यदानवाः ॥
अथोत्थितं रत्नसंघे सोमे श्रीकौस्तुभे गजे ॥ 23 ॥
4.118.m:
all the daityas and dānavas together churned the ocean.
Then, when the collection of jewels had arisen—the moon, Śrī, the Kaustubha gem, and the elephant—

4.118.s:
atilobhānmathyamāne sāgare payasāṃ nidhau ..
athotthitaṃ jvaladraudraṃ kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣam .. .. 24 ..
4.118.d:
अतिलोभान्मथ्यमाने सागरे पयसां निधौ ॥
अथोत्थितं ज्वलद्रौद्रं कालकूटं महाविषम् ॥ ॥ 24 ॥
4.118.m:
as the ocean, the reservoir of waters, was being churned out of excessive greed,
there arose the dreadful, blazing, great poison, Kālakūṭa,

4.118.s:
yenāsau surasaṃghāte āghūrṇitā ivābhavat ..
sāgaraṃ saṃpraviṣṭāste rātrau rātrau viniryuyuḥ ..25..
4.118.d:
येनासौ सुरसंघाते आघूर्णिता इवाभवत् ॥
सागरं संप्रविष्टास्ते रात्रौ रात्रौ विनिर्युयुः ॥25॥
4.118.m:
by which the multitude of gods was thrown into dizziness, as it were.
Having entered the ocean, they would emerge night after night;

4.118.s:
nirgamya ca vadhaṃ cakrurmunīnāmūrdhvaretasām..
babhaṃjuryajñapātrāṇi divā toye nililyire .. 26 ..
4.118.d:
निर्गम्य च वधं चक्रुर्मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम्॥
बभंजुर्यज्ञपात्राणि दिवा तोये निलिल्यिरे ॥ 26 ॥
4.118.m:
and having emerged, they carried out the slaughter of sages of upward-drawn semen,
broke the sacrificial vessels, and hid in the water by day.

4.118.s:
samudramadhye na jñātvā brahmā nārāyaṇo haraḥ ..
vāyuḥ kubero vasavaḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ... .. 27 ..
4.118.d:
समुद्रमध्ये न ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मा नारायणो हरः ॥
वायुः कुबेरो वसवः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ॥॥। 27 ॥
4.118.m:
Not knowing [them hidden] in the midst of the ocean, Brahmā, Nārāyaṇa, Hara,
Vāyu, Kubera, the Vasus, and all the gods headed by Indra—

4.118.s:
tato mantraiḥ śaṃkareṇa kiñcittatraiva bhakṣitam ..
kṣaṇāddagdhaḥ sa maṃtropi nīlakaṃṭhīkṛto haraḥ .. 28 ..
4.118.d:
ततो मन्त्रैः शंकरेण किञ्चित्तत्रैव भक्षितम् ॥
क्षणाद्दग्धः स मंत्रोपि नीलकंठीकृतो हरः ॥ 28 ॥
4.118.m:
then, with mantras, a little [of the poison] was consumed right there by Śaṅkara.
In an instant, even that mantra was burnt up, and Hara was made blue-throated.

4.118.s:
brahmāpi cetanāṃ prāpya abrahmaṇyamuvāca ha ..
nāsti kaścijagatyasminviṣamāpātumīśvara .. 29 ..
4.118.d:
ब्रह्मापि चेतनां प्राप्य अब्रह्मण्यमुवाच ह ॥
नास्ति कश्चिजगत्यस्मिन्विषमापातुमीश्वर ॥ 29 ॥
4.118.m:
Brahmā also, recovering consciousness, uttered a cry of distress:
'O Lord, there is no one in this world capable of drinking this poison!

4.118.s:
agastyo dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ laṅkāmūle mahāmuniḥ ..
tadgacchadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvadā hyasau .. 4.118.30 ..
4.118.d:
अगस्त्यो दक्षिणाशायां लङ्कामूले महामुनिः ॥
तद्गच्छध्वं महाभागाः शरणं सर्वदा ह्यसौ ॥ 4.118.30 ॥
4.118.m:
The great sage Agastya dwells in the southern quarter at the base of Laṅkā;
therefore go, O fortunate ones, to him, for he is always a refuge.'

4.118.s:
evamuktā gatā devā agastyāśramadakṣiṇām ..
devānvīkṣya ca tānharṣādagastyo munisattamaḥ .. 31 ..
4.118.d:
एवमुक्ता गता देवा अगस्त्याश्रमदक्षिणाम् ॥
देवान्वीक्ष्य च तान्हर्षादगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः ॥ 31 ॥
4.118.m:
Being thus addressed, the gods went to the south towards the hermitage of Agastya.
And seeing those gods, Agastya, the best of sages, out of joy

4.118.s:
dhyānaṃ cakre viṣaṃ yena himādrau saṃpraveśitam ..
kaṃṭhīsūtraṃ nikuṃjeṣu himaparvatasānuṣu .. 32 ..
4.118.d:
ध्यानं चक्रे विषं येन हिमाद्रौ संप्रवेशितम् ॥
कंठीसूत्रं निकुंजेषु हिमपर्वतसानुषु ॥ 32 ॥
4.118.m:
performed meditation, by which the poison was driven into the Himalaya mountain,
[like] a necklace in the bowers upon the slopes of the Snowy Mountain.

4.118.s:
tasminkāle viṣaṃ lagnaṃ kiñciccheṣaṃ drumādiṣu ..
unmattakaravīrārkasthalabhūmi jalānile .. 33 ..
4.118.d:
तस्मिन्काले विषं लग्नं किञ्चिच्छेषं द्रुमादिषु ॥
उन्मत्तकरवीरार्कस्थलभूमि जलानिले ॥ 33 ॥
4.118.m:
At that time, a certain remainder of the poison clung to trees and other things—
to the thorn apple, the oleander, and the swallow-wort, on dry land, in earth, water, and wind.

4.118.s:
tadviṣaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tena kṣaṇātsaṃkocitaṃ tathā ..
himavātena duṣṭena vahamānena pāṃḍava .. 34 ..
4.118.d:
तद्विषं चूर्णितं तेन क्षणात्संकोचितं तथा ॥
हिमवातेन दुष्टेन वहमानेन पांडव ॥ 34 ॥
4.118.m:
That poison was pulverized by him and instantly contracted.
Yet, as the tainted snowy wind blows, O son of Pāṇḍu,

4.118.s:
manuṣyāṇāṃ tu jāyaṃte rogā nānāvidhā bhuvi ..
te ca māsatrayaṃ sārddhaṃ pravahaṃti viṣolbaṇāḥ .. 35 ..
4.118.d:
मनुष्याणां तु जायंते रोगा नानाविधा भुवि ॥
ते च मासत्रयं सार्द्धं प्रवहंति विषोल्बणाः ॥ 35 ॥
4.118.m:
various kinds of diseases arise among human beings on earth,
and for three and a half months they blow, intense with poison.

4.118.s:
vṛṣasaṃkrātimārabhya siṃhāṃte śāmyate viṣam ..
rogadoṣāpanodaśca bhavetpārtha prabhāvataḥ .. 36 ..
4.118.d:
वृषसंक्रातिमारभ्य सिंहांते शाम्यते विषम् ॥
रोगदोषापनोदश्च भवेत्पार्थ प्रभावतः ॥ 36 ॥
4.118.m: Beginning from the Sun's transit into Taurus until the end of Leo, the poison is subdued, / and, O son of Pṛthā, by his power the defect of disease is dispelled.

4.118.s:
evaṃ kālena mahatā nīruje vyādhivarjite ..
jagatyasminpurā pārtha ghanībhūte prajāgaṇe .. 37 ..
4.118.d:
एवं कालेन महता नीरुजे व्याधिवर्जिते ॥
जगत्यस्मिन्पुरा पार्थ घनीभूते प्रजागणे ॥ 37 ॥
4.118.m: Thus, after a long time, when this world was free from sickness and devoid of disease, / and the multitude of creatures had become dense of old, O son of Pṛthā,

4.118.s:
niraṃtare martyaloke ūrdhvabāhu prasāriṇi ..
balavāndhūmanirdeśānmṛtyurbhrāmyati mūrtimān .. 38 ..
4.118.d:
निरंतरे मर्त्यलोके ऊर्ध्वबाहु प्रसारिणि ॥
बलवान्धूमनिर्देशान्मृत्युर्भ्राम्यति मूर्तिमान् ॥ 38 ॥
4.118.m: and the mortal world was crowded, with people stretching their arms upward, / mighty Death, taking embodied form, wandered about at the command of smoke.

4.118.s:
prajā vyāpādayankālādājagāma mahāmuneḥ ..
samīpaṃ mūrtimānkruddho mṛtyustena nirīkṣitaḥ .. 39 ..
4.118.d:
प्रजा व्यापादयन्कालादाजगाम महामुनेः ॥
समीपं मूर्तिमान्क्रुद्धो मृत्युस्तेन निरीक्षितः ॥ 39 ॥
4.118.m: Destroying creatures over time, Death, embodied and enraged, / came near the great sage, and was beheld by him.

4.118.s:
bhasmībabhūva paścācca brahmaṇaḥ sukhakāraṇāt ..
vyādhivṛndasamopeto mṛtyuranyo vinirmitaḥ ..4.118.40..
4.118.d:
भस्मीबभूव पश्चाच्च ब्रह्मणः सुखकारणात् ॥
व्याधिवृन्दसमोपेतो मृत्युरन्यो विनिर्मितः ॥4.118.40॥
4.118.m: He was reduced to ashes; and afterwards, for the happiness of Brahmā, / another Death, accompanied by a host of diseases, was created.

4.118.s:
tathānyo daṃḍakāraṇye śveto nāma nṛpottamaḥ ..
svamāṃsamaśnatā tena nirvedātprārthito muniḥ ..41..
4.118.d:
तथान्यो दंडकारण्ये श्वेतो नाम नृपोत्तमः ॥
स्वमांसमश्नता तेन निर्वेदात्प्रार्थितो मुनिः ॥41॥
4.118.m: Similarly, another [figure], the best of kings named Śveta in the Daṇḍaka forest, / while eating his own flesh, in despair besought the sage:

4.118.s:
bhagavatsarvamevānyaddattaṃ rājyamadānmayā ..
annaṃ jalaṃ vā śrāddhaṃ vā na dattaṃ pāpabuddhinā .. 42 ..
4.118.d:
भगवत्सर्वमेवान्यद्दत्तं राज्यमदान्मया ॥
अन्नं जलं वा श्राद्धं वा न दत्तं पापबुद्धिना ॥ 42 ॥
4.118.m: "O Blessed One, everything else was given by me out of the arrogance of royalty; / but food, water, or śrāddha was not given by me, sinful of mind."

4.118.s:
tato'gastyaḥ kāruṇyā ratnaiḥ śrāddhamakalpayat ..
śrāddhe nivṛtte sahasā divyadehaḥ śriyā vṛtaḥ .. 43 ..
4.118.d:
ततोऽगस्त्यः कारुण्या रत्नैः श्राद्धमकल्पयत् ॥
श्राद्धे निवृत्ते सहसा दिव्यदेहः श्रिया वृतः ॥ 43 ॥
4.118.m: Thereupon Agastya, out of compassion, arranged a śrāddha with jewels; / when the śrāddha was concluded, he instantly gained a divine body endowed with splendour,

4.118.s:
prāptaśca paramaṃ sthānamagastyarṣeḥ prasādataḥ ..
atha vindhyo mahāśailaḥ sūryaroṣādvyavardhata .. 44 ..
4.118.d:
प्राप्तश्च परमं स्थानमगस्त्यर्षेः प्रसादतः ॥
अथ विन्ध्यो महाशैलः सूर्यरोषाद्व्यवर्धत ॥ 44 ॥
4.118.m: and attained the supreme abode by the grace of the sage Agastya. / Then the great mountain Vindhya grew tall out of anger toward the Sun:

4.118.s:
kasmānmerumivāsau māṃ na karoti pradakṣiṇam ..
varddhamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tato devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 45 ..
4.118.d:
कस्मान्मेरुमिवासौ मां न करोति प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
वर्द्धमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा ततो देवाः सवासवाः ॥ 45 ॥
4.118.m: "Why does he not circumambulate me as he does Mount Meru?" / Seeing him growing, all the gods together with Indra,

4.118.s:
ekībhūyāśramaṃ gatvā stutvā devarṣipuṅgavam ..
agastyamūcurbhagavansūryamārganirodhinam .. 46 ..
4.118.d:
एकीभूयाश्रमं गत्वा स्तुत्वा देवर्षिपुङ्गवम् ॥
अगस्त्यमूचुर्भगवन्सूर्यमार्गनिरोधिनम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.118.m: having assembled, went to the hermitage, praised the eminent divine sage / Agastya, and said: "O Blessed One, the Vindhya obstructs the path of the Sun;

4.118.s:
viṃdhyaṃ nivāraya svainaṃ sthitau sthāpaya parvatam ..
agastyopi drutaṃ gatvā prāhedaṃ vindhyaparvatam .. 47 ..
4.118.d:
विंध्यं निवारय स्वैनं स्थितौ स्थापय पर्वतम् ॥
अगस्त्योपि द्रुतं गत्वा प्राहेदं विन्ध्यपर्वतम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.118.m: restrain this mountain and establish it in its proper state." / Agastya, too, having gone swiftly, spoke these words to the Vindhya mountain:

4.118.s:
prasthitaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ viddhi māmacalottama ..
sthitau ca sthīyatāṃ tāvadyāvadāgamanaṃ mama .. 48 ..
4.118.d:
प्रस्थितं तीर्थयात्रायां विद्धि मामचलोत्तम ॥
स्थितौ च स्थीयतां तावद्यावदागमनं मम ॥ 48 ॥
4.118.m: "Know that I have set out on a pilgrimage to sacred fords, O best of mountains; / remain in this state until my return."

4.118.s:
evamuktvā saṃprayāto nādyāpi vinivartate ..
dṛśyate bhrājayannāśāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gagane jvalan .. 49 ..
4.118.d:
एवमुक्त्वा संप्रयातो नाद्यापि विनिवर्तते ॥
दृश्यते भ्राजयन्नाशां दक्षिणां गगने ज्वलन् ॥ 49 ॥
4.118.m: Having spoken thus, he departed, and even today he does not return; / he is seen blazing in the sky, illuminating the southern quarter.

4.118.s:
trailokyavaṃdyacaraṇo lopāmudrāsahāyavān ..
lopāmudrāpi taṃ prāha devarṣiṃ devapūjitam .. 4.118.50 ..
4.118.d:
त्रैलोक्यवंद्यचरणो लोपामुद्रासहायवान् ॥
लोपामुद्रापि तं प्राह देवर्षिं देवपूजितम् ॥ 4.118.50 ॥
4.118.m: His feet are adored by the three worlds, and he is accompanied by Lopāmudrā; / Lopāmudrā also spoke to that divine sage worshipped by the gods,

4.118.s:
tatrāśramasthalikāyāmṛtukāle hyupasthite ..
bhoktumicchāmi viṣayāṃstvayā saha sukheṣiṇī.. 91 ..
4.118.d:
तत्राश्रमस्थलिकायामृतुकाले ह्युपस्थिते ॥
भोक्तुमिच्छामि विषयांस्त्वया सह सुखेषिणी॥ 91 ॥
4.118.m: there on the grounds of the hermitage, when her fertile period had arrived: / "Desiring pleasure, I wish to enjoy worldly pleasures with you,

4.118.s:
bhavedyadi gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam ..
gajai rathaiśca saṃpūrṇaṃ śayanaiḥ pravarāsanaiḥ .. 52 ..
4.118.d:
भवेद्यदि गृहं रम्यं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ॥
गजै रथैश्च संपूर्णं शयनैः प्रवरासनैः ॥ 52 ॥
4.118.m: if there should be a charming mansion adorned with all manner of jewels, / filled with elephants and chariots, with couches and excellent seats,

4.118.s:
dukūlapaṭṭanetraiśca vilāsairlalitairmune ..
tvayā saha samāyogaṃ yāsye'haṃ kuru cintitam .. 53 ..
4.118.d:
दुकूलपट्टनेत्रैश्च विलासैर्ललितैर्मुने ॥
त्वया सह समायोगं यास्येऽहं कुरु चिन्तितम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.118.m: with fine silk, woven silks, and delicate graces, O sage; / [then] I will unite with you; bring about what has been conceived."

4.118.s:
etacchutvā munihṛrṣṭaḥ prāhvayaddhanadaṃ kṣaṇāt ..
kārayāmāsa bhavanaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ratnarāśibhiḥ .. 54 ..
4.118.d:
एतच्छुत्वा मुनिहृर्ष्टः प्राह्वयद्धनदं क्षणात् ॥
कारयामास भवनं संपूर्णं रत्नराशिभिः ॥ 54 ॥
4.118.m: Hearing this, the delighted sage instantly summoned Kubera, / and caused a mansion to be built, filled with heaps of jewels.

4.118.s:
tatra reme sa bhagavānagastyaḥ svāśrame sukham ..
tasyaivaṃ ceṣṭitasyarṣeḥ prayacchārghyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 55 ..
4.118.d:
तत्र रेमे स भगवानगस्त्यः स्वाश्रमे सुखम् ॥
तस्यैवं चेष्टितस्यर्षेः प्रयच्छार्घ्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥ 55 ॥
4.118.m: There the blessed Agastya took his pleasure happily in his hermitage. / To that sage of such deeds, offer water of respect, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.118.s:
āstikyabuddhyā bhaktyā ca dhanaṃ prāpsyasi pāṃḍava ..
kanyāyāmāgate sūrye arvāgvai saptame dine .. 56..
4.118.d:
आस्तिक्यबुद्ध्या भक्त्या च धनं प्राप्स्यसि पांडव ॥
कन्यायामागते सूर्ये अर्वाग्वै सप्तमे दिने ॥ 56॥
4.118.m: With a devout disposition and with devotion, you will obtain wealth, O son of Pāṇḍu, / when the Sun has entered Virgo, or earlier on the seventh day.

4.118.s:
kanyāyāṃ samanuprāpte sūrye yaḥ sannivartate ..
pratyūṣasamaye vidvānkuryāvasyodaye niśi.. 57 ..
4.118.d:
कन्यायां समनुप्राप्ते सूर्ये यः सन्निवर्तते ॥
प्रत्यूषसमये विद्वान्कुर्यावस्योदये निशि॥ 57 ॥
4.118.m: When the Sun has fully reached Virgo, he who is restrained, / a wise man, should perform [the rite] at dawn, or at night upon its rising.

4.118.s:
snānaṃ śuklatilaistadvacchuklamālyāmbaro gṛhī ..
sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣitam ..58..
4.118.d:
स्नानं शुक्लतिलैस्तद्वच्छुक्लमाल्याम्बरो गृही ॥
स्थापयेदव्रणं कुंभं माल्यवस्त्रविभूषितम् ॥58॥
4.118.m: Having bathed with white sesame seeds, wearing white garlands and garments, the householder / should set up an unblemished jar adorned with garlands and cloth,

4.118.s:
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
nānābhakṣyasamopetaṃ saptadhānyasamanvitam .. 59 ..
4.118.d:
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥
नानाभक्ष्यसमोपेतं सप्तधान्यसमन्वितम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.118.m: endowed with the five gems, accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter, / provided with various cooked foods, and furnished with the seven grains.

4.118.s:
kāñcanaṃ kārayitvā tu yathāśaktyā suśobhanam ..
puruṣākṛtiṃ praśāntaṃ ca japamaṇḍaladhāriṇam ..4.118.60..
4.118.d:
काञ्चनं कारयित्वा तु यथाशक्त्या सुशोभनम् ॥
पुरुषाकृतिं प्रशान्तं च जपमण्डलधारिणम् ॥4.118.60॥
4.118.m: Having fashioned an image of gold according to one's means, very beautiful, / having human form, serene, holding a rosary,

4.118.s:
kamaṇḍalukaraṃ śiṣyairmṛgaiśca paridhāritam ..
mṛtyughnaṃ viṣahantāraṃ darbhākṣeṣṭakaraṃ munim..61..
4.118.d:
कमण्डलुकरं शिष्यैर्मृगैश्च परिधारितम् ॥
मृत्युघ्नं विषहन्तारं दर्भाक्षेष्टकरं मुनिम्॥61॥
4.118.m: with a water-pot in hand, surrounded by disciples and deer, / the destroyer of Death, the slayer of poison, the sage with darbha grass and akṣa beads in his hand;

4.118.s:
tasminkrame samālagnaṃ candanena tato nyaset..
snāpitaṃ cānuliptaṃ ca candanena sugaṃdhinā ..62..
4.118.d:
तस्मिन्क्रमे समालग्नं चन्दनेन ततो न्यसेत्॥
स्नापितं चानुलिप्तं च चन्दनेन सुगंधिना ॥62॥
4.118.m: then one should place it, smeared with sandalwood, in that order, / having bathed it and anointed it with fragrant sandalwood,

4.118.s:
pūjitaṃ cāpi kusumairhṛdyairdhūpaistu dhūpitam ..
tataścārghaṃ pradātavyo yairdravyaistāni me śṛṇu .. 63 ..
4.118.d:
पूजितं चापि कुसुमैर्हृद्यैर्धूपैस्तु धूपितम् ॥
ततश्चार्घं प्रदातव्यो यैर्द्रव्यैस्तानि मे शृणु ॥ 63 ॥
4.118.m: and worshipped it with delightful flowers and censed it with incenses. / Then the water of respect is to be offered; hear from me the substances with which [it is offered]:

4.118.s:
kharjūrairnālikeraiśca kūṣmāṃḍaistrapuṣairapi ..
karkoṭakāravellaiśca karcūrairbījapūrakaiḥ ..64..
4.118.d:
खर्जूरैर्नालिकेरैश्च कूष्मांडैस्त्रपुषैरपि ॥
कर्कोटकारवेल्लैश्च कर्चूरैर्बीजपूरकैः ॥64॥
4.118.m: with dates and coconuts, with white gourds and cucumbers, / with spine gourds and bitter gourds, with white turmeric and citrons,

4.118.s:
vṛṃtākairdāḍimaiścaiva nāraṃgaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ ..
dūrvāṃkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ kāśaiḥ padmainīlotpalaistathā .. 65 ..
4.118.d:
वृंताकैर्दाडिमैश्चैव नारंगैः कदलीफलैः ॥
दूर्वांकुरैः कुशैः काशैः पद्मैनीलोत्पलैस्तथा ॥ 65 ॥
4.118.m: with eggplants and pomegranates, with oranges and plantain fruits, / with sprouts of dūrvā grass, kuśa grass, kāśa grass, and with lotuses and blue water-lilies,

4.118.s:
nānāprakārairbhakṣyaiśca gobhirvastrai rasaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca vaṃśapātre nidhāpitaiḥ ..66..
4.118.d:
नानाप्रकारैर्भक्ष्यैश्च गोभिर्वस्त्रै रसैः शुभैः ॥
विरूढैः सप्तधान्यैश्च वंशपात्रे निधापितैः ॥66॥
4.118.m: with various kinds of foods, with cattle, cloths, auspicious liquids, / and with the seven sprouted grains placed in a bamboo vessel,

4.118.s:
sauvarṇaraupyapātreṇa tāmravaṃśamayena ca ..
mūrdhni sthitena namreṇa jānubhyāṃ pṛthivītale .. 67 ..
4.118.d:
सौवर्णरौप्यपात्रेण ताम्रवंशमयेन च ॥
मूर्ध्नि स्थितेन नम्रेण जानुभ्यां पृथिवीतले ॥ 67 ॥
4.118.m: or with a golden, silver, copper, or bamboo vessel / placed upon the head, bowing with knees upon the surface of the earth.

4.118.s:
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā hyarghyapādyādikaṃ ca yat ..
śīlena cetasā bhaktyā dadyātkauravanandana .. 68 ..
4.118.d:
दक्षिणाभिमुखो भूत्वा ह्यर्घ्यपाद्यादिकं च यत् ॥
शीलेन चेतसा भक्त्या दद्यात्कौरवनन्दन ॥ 68 ॥
4.118.m: Facing the south, with a serene mind and with devotion, / one should present whatever water of respect, water for washing the feet, and the like, O joy of the Kurus.

4.118.s:
kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa agnimārutasaṃbhava ..
mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kuṃbhayone namo'stu te .. 65. ..
viṃdhyavṛddhikṣayakara meṣatoyaviṣāpaha ..
rakto vallabhadevarṣe laṃkāvāsa namo'stu te .. 4.118.70 ..
4.118.d:
काशपुष्पप्रतीकाश अग्निमारुतसंभव ॥
मित्रावरुणयोः पुत्र कुंभयोने नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 65॥।
विंध्यवृद्धिक्षयकर मेषतोयविषापह ॥
रक्तो वल्लभदेवर्षे लंकावास नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 4.118.70 ॥
4.118.m: "O you who resemble the kāśa flower, born of fire and wind, / son of Mitra and Varuṇa, jar-born one, homage be to you! / / O destroyer of the growth of the Vindhya, remover of the poison of the waters of Aries, / beloved, dear divine sage, dweller of Laṅkā, homage be to you!

4.118.s:
vātāpirbhakṣito yena samudrāḥ śoṣitāḥ purā ..
lopāmudrāpatiḥ śrīmānyo'sau tasmai namo'stu te .. 71 ..
4.118.d:
वातापिर्भक्षितो येन समुद्राः शोषिताः पुरा ॥
लोपामुद्रापतिः श्रीमान्योऽसौ तस्मै नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 71 ॥
4.118.m: By whom Vātāpi was eaten, by whom the oceans were dried up of old, / the glorious husband of Lopāmudrā—homage be to him!

4.118.s:
yenoditena pāpāni pralayaṃ yāṃti vyādhayaḥ ..
tasmai namo'stvagastyāya saśiṣyāya suputriṇe ..
brāhmaṇo vedaṛcayā dadyādarghyaṃ namo'stu te .. 72 ..
4.118.d:
येनोदितेन पापानि प्रलयं यांति व्याधयः ॥
तस्मै नमोऽस्त्वगस्त्याय सशिष्याय सुपुत्रिणे ॥
ब्राह्मणो वेदऋचया दद्यादर्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 72 ॥
4.118.m: Upon whose rising, sins and diseases go to destruction— / homage be to that Agastya, together with his disciples, having noble sons!" / A brāhmaṇa should offer water of respect with a Vedic verse: "Homage be to you!"

4.118.s:
agastyaḥ khanamānaśca nityaṃ prājāpatyaṃ balimicchamānaḥ ..
ubhau varṇau vṛṣṭyanugrahārthamupoṣa satyādeṣvaśikho jagāma ..'
dattvaivamarghyaṃ kauṃteya pratipūjya ca puṣpakaiḥ ..
visarjayitvāgastyaṃ taṃ viprāya pratipādayet .. 73 ..
4.118.d:
अगस्त्यः खनमानश्च नित्यं प्राजापत्यं बलिमिच्छमानः ॥
उभौ वर्णौ वृष्ट्यनुग्रहार्थमुपोष सत्यादेष्वशिखो जगाम ॥'
दत्त्वैवमर्घ्यं कौंतेय प्रतिपूज्य च पुष्पकैः ॥
विसर्जयित्वागस्त्यं तं विप्राय प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 73 ॥
4.118.m: "Agastya, continually digging and desiring an offering to Prajāpati, / fostered both castes for the sake of rainfall and, firm in his vows, went forth." / Having thus given the water of respect, O son of Kuntī, and having worshipped him with flowers, / having bidden farewell to that Agastya, one should present him to a brāhmaṇa,

4.118.s:
daivajñavyāsarūpāya vedavedāṃgavādine ..
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā hyagastyapratipūjanam ..
phalamekaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ kopaṃ vāsaṃ parityajet .. 74 ..
4.118.d:
दैवज्ञव्यासरूपाय वेदवेदांगवादिने ॥
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या ह्यगस्त्यप्रतिपूजनम् ॥
फलमेकं तथा धान्यं कोपं वासं परित्यजेत् ॥ 74 ॥
4.118.m: who has the form of an astrologer or of Vyāsa, and who professes the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. / Whoever thus performs the worship of Agastya with devotion / should renounce one fruit, and likewise a grain, anger, or garment.

4.118.s:
saṃpūrṇe ca tato varṣe punara nyadupakramet ..
dattvārghyaṃ saptavarṣāṇi krameṇānena pāṃḍava ..
pumānphalamavāpnoti tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu .. 75 ..
4.118.d:
संपूर्णे च ततो वर्षे पुनर न्यदुपक्रमेत् ॥
दत्त्वार्घ्यं सप्तवर्षाणि क्रमेणानेन पांडव ॥
पुमान्फलमवाप्नोति तदेकाग्रमनाः शृणु ॥ 75 ॥
4.118.m: And when a year is completed, he should again commence another [renunciation]; / having given the water of respect for seven years according to this order, O son of Pāṇḍu, / a man attains the fruit; hear that with a concentrated mind:

4.118.s:
brāhmaṇaścaturo vedānsarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ prāpnotyarṇavamekhalām ..76..
4.118.d:
ब्राह्मणश्चतुरो वेदान्सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ॥
क्षत्रियः पृथिवीं सर्वां प्राप्नोत्यर्णवमेखलाम् ॥76॥
4.118.m: A brāhmaṇa becomes learned in all the śāstras and the four Vedas; / a kṣatriya attains the entire earth, ocean-girdled.

4.118.s:
vaiśyo'pyāyuṣyamāpnoti godhanaṃ cāpi naṃdati..
śūdrāṇāṃ dhanamārogyaṃ sanmānaścādhiko bhavet .. 77 ..
4.118.d:
वैश्योऽप्यायुष्यमाप्नोति गोधनं चापि नंदति॥
शूद्राणां धनमारोग्यं सन्मानश्चाधिको भवेत् ॥ 77 ॥
4.118.m: The vaiśya also attains longevity and rejoices in cattle-wealth; / for śūdras there is wealth, good health, and greater honour.

4.118.s:
strīṇāṃ putrāḥ prajāyaṃte saubhāgyaṃ vṛddhiṛddhimat ..
vidhavānāṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vardhate pāṃḍunandana.. 78 ..
4.118.d:
स्त्रीणां पुत्राः प्रजायंते सौभाग्यं वृद्धिऋद्धिमत् ॥
विधवानां महापुण्यं वर्धते पांडुनन्दन॥ 78 ॥
4.118.m: Sons are born to women, along with auspicious fortune, prosperity, and abundance; / for widows, O son of Pāṇḍu, great merit increases.

4.118.s: kanyā bhartāramāpnoti vyādhermucyeta duḥkhitaḥ..79..
4.118.d: कन्या भर्तारमाप्नोति व्याधेर्मुच्येत दुःखितः॥79॥
4.118.m: A maiden obtains a husband, and a sufferer is freed from illness.

4.118.s:
yeṣu deśeṣvagastyarṣeḥ pūjanaṃ kriyate janaiḥ ..
teṣu deśeṣu parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī prajāyate ..4.118.80..
4.118.d:
येषु देशेष्वगस्त्यर्षेः पूजनं क्रियते जनैः ॥
तेषु देशेषु पर्जन्यः कामवर्षी प्रजायते ॥4.118.80॥
4.118.m: In whatever lands worship of the sage Agastya is performed by the people, / in those lands Parjanya sends rain according to desire.

4.118.s:
ītayaḥ praśamaṃ yāṃti naśyaṃti vyādha yastathā ..
paṭhaṃti ye tvagastyarṣeḥ khyānaṃ śṛṇvaṃti cāpare .. 81 ..
4.118.d:
ईतयः प्रशमं यांति नश्यंति व्याध यस्तथा ॥
पठंति ये त्वगस्त्यर्षेः ख्यानं शृण्वंति चापरे ॥ 81 ॥
4.118.m: Calamities subside, and diseases also vanish. / Those who recite the narrative of the sage Agastya, and others who listen to it,

4.118.s:
te sarve pāpanirmuktāściraṃ sthitvā mahītale ..
haṃsayuktavimānena svargaṃ yāṃti narottama..82..
4.118.d:
ते सर्वे पापनिर्मुक्ताश्चिरं स्थित्वा महीतले ॥
हंसयुक्तविमानेन स्वर्गं यांति नरोत्तम॥82॥
4.118.m: they all, freed from sin, having dwelt long on the surface of the earth, / go to heaven on a swan-borne celestial chariot, O best of men.

4.118.s:
martyo yadīcchati gṛhaṃ paramarddhiyuktaṃ bhogaśarīramarujaṃ paśuputrapuṣṭim..
tatsarvavallabhamunerudaye mahārghyaṃ yacchenmahārghaphalavastradhanaiḥ sahānyaiḥ.. .. 83 ..
4.118.d:
मर्त्यो यदीच्छति गृहं परमर्द्धियुक्तं भोगशरीरमरुजं पशुपुत्रपुष्टिम्॥
तत्सर्ववल्लभमुनेरुदये महार्घ्यं यच्छेन्महार्घफलवस्त्रधनैः सहान्यैः॥ ॥ 83 ॥
4.118.m: If a mortal desires a house endowed with supreme prosperity, an enjoyable body free from disease, and the flourishing of cattle and sons, / at the rising of that sage dear to all he should offer the great arghya together with costly fruits, garments, and other treasures.

4.118.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde
'gastyārghyavidhivratavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 118 ..
abhinavacandrārghyavratavarṇanam
4.118.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे
ऽगस्त्यार्घ्यविधिव्रतवर्णनं नामाष्टादशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 118 ॥
अभिनवचन्द्रार्घ्यव्रतवर्णनम्
4.118.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and eighteenth chapter, entitled ‘The Description of the Votive Observance of the Arghya Rite to Agastya’, in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Votive Observance of the Arghya to the New Moon

4.119.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārtha pārthiva divyastrīmukhapaṃkajaseṃdave ..
śṛṇuṣvābhinavasyeṃdorudaye'rghyavidhiṃ param .. 1 ..
4.119.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पार्थ पार्थिव दिव्यस्त्रीमुखपंकजसेंदवे ॥
शृणुष्वाभिनवस्येंदोरुदयेऽर्घ्यविधिं परम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.119.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / O Pārtha, O ruler of the earth, possessing a face resembling a lotus and the moon among divine women, / hear the supreme rite of offering arghya at the rising of the new moon.

4.119.s:
ravirdvādaśabhirbhāgairvāruṇyāṃ dṛśyate yadi ..
pradoṣasamaye pārtha arghyaṃ dadyāttadā vibhoḥ .. 2 ..
4.119.d:
रविर्द्वादशभिर्भागैर्वारुण्यां दृश्यते यदि ॥
प्रदोषसमये पार्थ अर्घ्यं दद्यात्तदा विभोः ॥ 2 ॥
4.119.m: When the sun is seen at twelve degrees in the west / at dusk, O Pārtha, one should then offer arghya to the Lord.

4.119.s:
dvitīyāyāṃ site pakṣe saṃdhyākāle hyupasthite ..
saṃsthāpyābhinavaṃ candraṃ sa bhūmyāṃ dṛśyate yadi .. 3 ..
4.119.d:
द्वितीयायां सिते पक्षे संध्याकाले ह्युपस्थिते ॥
संस्थाप्याभिनवं चन्द्रं स भूम्यां दृश्यते यदि ॥ 3 ॥
4.119.m: On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight, when twilight has arrived, / having installed the new moon, if it is seen on earth,

4.119.s:
gomayaṃ maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā caṃdanena suśobhitam..
rohiṇyā sahitaṃ devaṃ kumudāmodasaṃbhavam.. 4 ..
4.119.d:
गोमयं मंडलं कृत्वा चंदनेन सुशोभितम्॥
रोहिण्या सहितं देवं कुमुदामोदसंभवम्॥ 4 ॥
4.119.m: having made a circular mandala of cow dung beautifully adorned with sandalwood paste, / [one should worship] the god accompanied by Rohiṇī, the source of fragrance for the night-lotus,

4.119.s:
puṣpacandanadhūpaiśca dīpākṣatajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
dūrvāṃkurai ratnavarairdadhnā vastraiśca pāṃḍuraiḥ .. 5 ..
4.119.d:
पुष्पचन्दनधूपैश्च दीपाक्षतजलैः शुभैः ॥
दूर्वांकुरै रत्नवरैर्दध्ना वस्त्रैश्च पांडुरैः ॥ 5 ॥
4.119.m: with flowers, sandalwood paste, incense, lamps, unbroken rice, pure water, / dūrvā sprouts, excellent gems, curd, and white garments.

4.119.s:
maṃtreṇānena rājendra kṣatriyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ..
navonavo'si māsāṃte jāyamānaḥ puna. punaḥ ..
āpyāyasva sametvevaṃ somarāja namonamaḥ .. 6 ..
4.119.d:
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र क्षत्रियः सपुरोहितः ॥
नवोनवोऽसि मासांते जायमानः पुन। पुनः ॥
आप्यायस्व समेत्वेवं सोमराज नमोनमः ॥ 6 ॥
4.119.m: With this mantra, O king of kings, the kṣatriya accompanied by his family priest [should recite]: / ‘You are ever new, born again and again at the end of the month; / swell up, come together thus! O King Soma, homage, homage to you!’

4.119.s:
anenavidhinācāryaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
yaḥ prayacchati kauṃteya māsimāsi samāhitaḥ .. 7 ..
4.119.d:
अनेनविधिनाचार्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥
यः प्रयच्छति कौंतेय मासिमासि समाहितः ॥ 7 ॥
4.119.m: According to this rite, the offering that grants the fruit of all desires / whoever offers month after month with concentrated mind, O son of Kuntī,

4.119.s:
sa kīrtyā yaśasā kāṃtyā dhanyaśca bhuvi mānavaḥ ..
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto godhānyadhanasaṃkulaḥ .. 8 ..
4.119.d:
स कीर्त्या यशसा कांत्या धन्यश्च भुवि मानवः ॥
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतो गोधान्यधनसंकुलः ॥ 8 ॥
4.119.m: that man becomes blessed on earth with renown, fame, and radiance; / surrounded by sons and grandsons, replete with cattle, grain, and wealth,

4.119.s:
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye tataḥ somapuraṃ vrajet ..
tatrāste divyavapuṣā bhogānbhuñjannṛpottama ..
varastrībhiḥ sahātyarthaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 9 ..
4.119.d:
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं मर्त्ये ततः सोमपुरं व्रजेत् ॥
तत्रास्ते दिव्यवपुषा भोगान्भुञ्जन्नृपोत्तम ॥
वरस्त्रीभिः सहात्यर्थं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.119.m: having dwelt in the mortal world for a hundred years, he then goes to the city of Soma. / There he remains with a divine body, enjoying delights, O best of kings, / in the company of excellent women exceedingly until the cosmic deluge.

4.119.s:
dharmaṃ samṛddhimatulāṃ yadi vāñchasi tvaṃ māsānumāsamiha madvacanaṃ kuruṣva ..
somasya somakulanaṃdana dhūpapuṣpairarghaṃ prayaccha natajānu navoditasya .. 4.119.10 ..
śukrabṛhaspatyarghapūjāvarṇanam
4.119.d:
धर्मं समृद्धिमतुलां यदि वाञ्छसि त्वं मासानुमासमिह मद्वचनं कुरुष्व ॥
सोमस्य सोमकुलनंदन धूपपुष्पैरर्घं प्रयच्छ नतजानु नवोदितस्य ॥ 4.119.10 ॥
शुक्रबृहस्पत्यर्घपूजावर्णनम्
4.119.m:
If you desire righteousness and matchless prosperity, month after month here perform my word: / O delight of the lunar race, offer arghya with incense and flowers on bended knees to the newly risen Soma.
Description of the Arghya Worship of Śukra and Bṛhaspati

4.120.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athātaḥ śṛṇu bhūpāla pratiśukrapraśāṃtaye ..
yātrāraṃbhe prayāṇe ca tathā śukrodayeṣviha .. 1 ..
4.120.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथातः शृणु भूपाल प्रतिशुक्रप्रशांतये ॥
यात्रारंभे प्रयाणे च तथा शुक्रोदयेष्विह ॥ 1 ॥
4.120.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Now then, O ruler of the earth, listen, for the pacification of adverse Venus, / at the beginning of an expedition, during a march, and also at the risings of Venus here:

4.120.s:
śukrapūjā prakartavyā tāṃ niśāmaya sārataḥ ..
rājate vā'tha sauvarṇe kāṃsyapātre'tha vā punaḥ .. 2 ..
4.120.d:
शुक्रपूजा प्रकर्तव्या तां निशामय सारतः ॥
राजते वाऽथ सौवर्णे कांस्यपात्रेऽथ वा पुनः ॥ 2 ॥
4.120.m: the worship of Śukra should be performed; hear it in essence. / Either in a silver, or in a golden, or again in a bronze vessel,

4.120.s:
śuklapuṣpāṃbarayute sitataṃḍulapūrite ..
nidhāya rājataṃ śukraṃ śuci muktāphalānvitam .. 3 ..
4.120.d:
शुक्लपुष्पांबरयुते सिततंडुलपूरिते ॥
निधाय राजतं शुक्रं शुचि मुक्ताफलान्वितम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.120.m: provided with white flowers and cloth, filled with white unbroken rice, / placing a silver Śukra, clean and accompanied by pearls,

4.120.s:
saha tena savatsāṅgāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
namaste sarvadeveśa namaste bhṛgunandana ..
kave sarvārthasiddhyarthaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te..4..
4.120.d:
सह तेन सवत्साङ्गां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
नमस्ते सर्वदेवेश नमस्ते भृगुनन्दन ॥
कवे सर्वार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं गृहाणार्घ्यं नमोऽस्तु ते॥4॥
4.120.m: one should present it together with a cow and its calf to a brāhmaṇa: / ‘Homage to you, O lord of all gods! Homage to you, O son of Bhṛgu! / O poet, for the attainment of all ends, accept the arghya; homage be to you!’
Having offered the arghya thus, O son of Kuntī, prostrating oneself, one should bid farewell.

4.120.s:
yāvacchukrasya na kṛtā pūjā sohālakaiḥ śubhai. ..
vaṭakaiḥ pūrikābhiśca godhūmaiścaṇakairapi ..
tāvanna dānaṃ dātavyaṃ strībhiḥ kāmārthasiddhaye ..6..
4.120.d:
यावच्छुक्रस्य न कृता पूजा सोहालकैः शुभै॥।
वटकैः पूरिकाभिश्च गोधूमैश्चणकैरपि ॥
तावन्न दानं दातव्यं स्त्रीभिः कामार्थसिद्धये ॥6॥
4.120.m: As long as the worship of Śukra has not been performed with auspicious sohālakas, / vaṭakas, pūrikās, wheat, and chickpeas, / so long no gift should be given by women for the attainment of their desired ends.

4.120.s:
evaṃ tasyodaye kurvanyātrādiṣu ca bhārata ..
sarvasasyāgamaṃ caiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 7 ..
4.120.d:
एवं तस्योदये कुर्वन्यात्रादिषु च भारत ॥
सर्वसस्यागमं चैव सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 7 ॥
4.120.m: Performing thus at his rising and during journeys, O descendant of Bharata, / one will obtain an arrival of all crops and all desires.

4.120.s:
tadvadvācaspateḥ pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
sauvarṇapātre sauvarṇamamareśapurohitam ..
pītapuṣpāṃbarayutaṃ kṛtvā snātvātha sarṣapaiḥ ..8..
4.120.d:
तद्वद्वाचस्पतेः पूजां प्रवक्ष्यामि युधिष्ठिर ॥
सौवर्णपात्रे सौवर्णममरेशपुरोहितम् ॥
पीतपुष्पांबरयुतं कृत्वा स्नात्वाथ सर्षपैः ॥8॥
4.120.m: In the same way I shall declare the worship of Vācaspati, O Yudhiṣṭhira: / in a golden vessel, [placing] a golden priest of the lord of immortals, / provided with yellow flowers and cloth, and having bathed with mustard seeds,

4.120.s:
pālāśāśvatthabhaṃgena pañcagavyajalena ca..
pītāṃgarāgavasanaṃ ghṛtahomaṃ tu kārayeta .. 9 ..
4.120.d:
पालाशाश्वत्थभंगेन पञ्चगव्यजलेन च॥
पीतांगरागवसनं घृतहोमं तु कारयेत ॥ 9 ॥
4.120.m: with crushed twigs of palāśa and aśvattha, and with the water of the five bovine products, / having yellow body-ointment and garments, one should cause an oblation of clarified butter to be made.

4.120.s: praṇamya ca gavā sārddhaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 4.120.10 ..
4.120.d: प्रणम्य च गवा सार्द्धं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 4.120.10 ॥
4.120.m: And having bowed, one should present it together with a cow to a brāhmaṇa:

4.120.s:
namaste'ṅgirasāṃ nātha vākpatetha bṛhaspate ..
krūragrahaiḥ pīḍitānāmamṛtāya bhavasva naḥ .. 11 ..
4.120.d:
नमस्तेऽङ्गिरसां नाथ वाक्पतेथ बृहस्पते ॥
क्रूरग्रहैः पीडितानाममृताय भवस्व नः ॥ 11 ॥
4.120.m: ‘Homage to you, O lord of the Aṅgirases, O lord of speech, O Bṛhaspati! / For those of us afflicted by cruel planets, become nectar!’

4.120.s:
evaṃ suraguruṃ pūjya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet ..
saṃkrātāvudaye cāste sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 12 ..
4.120.d:
एवं सुरगुरुं पूज्य प्रणिपत्य क्षमापयेत् ॥
संक्रातावुदये चास्ते सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 12 ॥
4.120.m: Having thus worshipped the preceptor of the gods, bowing down, one should ask for forgiveness. / At an equinox or solstice, at his rising and setting, one will obtain all desires.

4.120.s:
atha vā mauktikānyeva suvṛttāni bṛhaṃti ca ..
bhārgavāṃgirasau ciṃtya tānyeva pratipādayet .. 13 ..
4.120.d:
अथ वा मौक्तिकान्येव सुवृत्तानि बृहंति च ॥
भार्गवांगिरसौ चिंत्य तान्येव प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.120.m: Or else large, well-rounded pearls: / meditating on the son of Bhṛgu and the son of Aṅgiras, one should bestow those very things.

4.120.s:
bhaktyā mauktikadānena dattena kurunandana ..
virūpatā dṛśoḥ puṃsāṃ yātrāsvabhyudayeṣu ca ..
kurvanbṛhaspateḥ pūjāṃ na kadācitprajāyate .. 14 ..
4.120.d:
भक्त्या मौक्तिकदानेन दत्तेन कुरुनन्दन ॥
विरूपता दृशोः पुंसां यात्रास्वभ्युदयेषु च ॥
कुर्वन्बृहस्पतेः पूजां न कदाचित्प्रजायते ॥ 14 ॥
4.120.m: Through devotion, by the given gift of pearls, O delight of the Kurus, / and worshipping Bṛhaspati, deformity of the eyes in men / during journeys and risings never occurs.

4.120.s:
ye bhārgavodayamavāpya savastrapuṣpāṃ kurvaṃtyananya manaso'ṅgirase ca pūjām ..
teṣāṃ gṛhe praviśatāṃ pratiśukrajātaṃ vighnaṃ na saṃbhavati bhārata puṇyabhājām .. 15 ..
vratapañcāśītivarṇanam
4.120.d:
ये भार्गवोदयमवाप्य सवस्त्रपुष्पां कुर्वंत्यनन्य मनसोऽङ्गिरसे च पूजाम् ॥
तेषां गृहे प्रविशतां प्रतिशुक्रजातं विघ्नं न संभवति भारत पुण्यभाजाम् ॥ 15 ॥
व्रतपञ्चाशीतिवर्णनम्
4.120.m:
Those who, having met the rising of the son of Bhṛgu, perform worship with garments and flowers with undivided mind to the descendant of Aṅgiras— / for those meritorious ones entering their home, O descendant of Bharata, no obstacle caused by adverse Venus arises.
Description of the Eighty-Five Votive Observances

4.121.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu bhārata vakṣyāmi pañcāśītivratāni ca ..
noktāni yāni kasyāpi munibhirdharmadarśibhiḥ .. 1 ..
4.121.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु भारत वक्ष्यामि पञ्चाशीतिव्रतानि च ॥
नोक्तानि यानि कस्यापि मुनिभिर्धर्मदर्शिभिः ॥ 1 ॥
4.121.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O descendant of Bharata, I shall declare the eighty-five votive observances / which have not been spoken of to anyone by the sages discerning dharma.

4.121.s:
bhaviṣyamatsyamārtaṃḍapurāṇeṣu ca varṇitam ..
vārāhaṃ caiva saṃgṛhya kathyaṃte tāni pāṃḍava .. 2 ..
4.121.d:
भविष्यमत्स्यमार्तंडपुराणेषु च वर्णितम् ॥
वाराहं चैव संगृह्य कथ्यंते तानि पांडव ॥ 2 ॥
4.121.m: What is described in the Bhaviṣya, Matsya, and Mārtaṇḍa Purāṇas, / and taking from the Vārāha, they are spoken, O son of Pāṇḍu.

4.121.s:
yadabhīṣṭaṃ sumitrāya śiṣyāya ca sutāya ca ..
na kathyate dharmajātaṃ kiṃ tenodaravartinā .. 3 ..
4.121.d:
यदभीष्टं सुमित्राय शिष्याय च सुताय च ॥
न कथ्यते धर्मजातं किं तेनोदरवर्तिना ॥ 3 ॥
4.121.m: That which is beloved to a good friend, a disciple, and a son, / if the group of dharmas is not told, what is the use of it remaining in the belly?

4.121.s:
śrutismṛtipurāṇebhyo yanmayā hyavadhāritam ..
tatte vacmi kuruśreṣṭha kasyānyasyopadiśyate .. 4 ..
4.121.d:
श्रुतिस्मृतिपुराणेभ्यो यन्मया ह्यवधारितम् ॥
तत्ते वच्मि कुरुश्रेष्ठ कस्यान्यस्योपदिश्यते ॥ 4 ॥
4.121.m: What has indeed been ascertained by me from the Vedas, the smṛtis, and the Purāṇas, / that I declare to you, best of Kurus; to what other person could it be taught?

4.121.s:
snātvā prabhātasaṃdhyāyāmupagṛhya ca pippalam ..
tilapātrāṇi yo dadyānna sa śoceta tatkṛte .. 5 ..
4.121.d:
स्नात्वा प्रभातसंध्यायामुपगृह्य च पिप्पलम् ॥
तिलपात्राणि यो दद्यान्न स शोचेत तत्कृते ॥ 5 ॥
4.121.m: Having bathed at the morning twilight and taken a pippala [leaf], / whoever gives vessels filled with sesame seeds does not grieve on that account.

4.121.s:
vratānāmuttamaṃ hyetatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
pātravratamiti khyātaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā .. 6 ..
4.121.d:
व्रतानामुत्तमं ह्येतत्सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
पात्रव्रतमिति ख्यातं नाख्यातं कस्यचिन्मया ॥ 6 ॥
4.121.m: For this is the best of votive observances, destroying all sins, / renowned as the Pātravrata; it has never been told by me to anyone.

4.121.s:
suśuddhasya suvarṇasya suvarṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
puṇye'hni viprakathite prītyā pītayugānvitam .. 7 ..
4.121.d:
सुशुद्धस्य सुवर्णस्य सुवर्णं यः प्रयच्छति ॥
पुण्येऽह्नि विप्रकथिते प्रीत्या पीतयुगान्वितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.121.m: Whoever gives a suvarṇa of very pure gold, / together with a pair of yellow garments, with devotion on an auspicious day declared by a brāhmaṇa,

4.121.s:
vrataṃ vācaspateretadbalabuddhipradāyakam ..
vṛtraghnasya purākhyātaṃ guruṇā sarvakāmadam .. 8 ..
4.121.d:
व्रतं वाचस्पतेरेतद्बलबुद्धिप्रदायकम् ॥
वृत्रघ्नस्य पुराख्यातं गुरुणा सर्वकामदम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.121.m: this is the votive observance of Vācaspati, granting strength and intellect, / granting all desires, which was told in ancient times to the slayer of Vṛtra by [his] guru.

4.121.s:
lavaṇaṃ kaṭutiktaṃ ca jīrakaṃ maricāni ca ..
hiṃguśuṃṭhisamāyuktaṃ sarvaṃ paricayaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
4.121.d:
लवणं कटुतिक्तं च जीरकं मरिचानि च ॥
हिंगुशुंठिसमायुक्तं सर्वं परिचयं तथा ॥ 9 ॥
4.121.m: Salt, pungent and bitter [spices], cumin and black pepper, / combined with asafoetida and dry ginger, and everything customary;

4.121.s:
caturthyā mekabhaktāśī sakṛddattvā kuṭuṃbine ..
gṛheṣu saptasu sadā śilāyuktāni bhārata .. 4.121.10 ..
4.121.d:
चतुर्थ्या मेकभक्ताशी सकृद्दत्त्वा कुटुंबिने ॥
गृहेषु सप्तसु सदा शिलायुक्तानि भारत ॥ 4.121.10 ॥
4.121.m: eating a single meal on the fourth lunar day, having once given [these] to a householder / in seven houses, always accompanied by a grindstone, O descendant of Bharata,

4.121.s:
etacchilāvrataṃ nāma lakṣmīlokapradāyakam ..
kartavyamiha yatnena mukhapāṭavakārakam .. 11 ..
4.121.d:
एतच्छिलाव्रतं नाम लक्ष्मीलोकप्रदायकम् ॥
कर्तव्यमिह यत्नेन मुखपाटवकारकम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.121.m: this is named the Śilāvrata, granting the realm of Lakṣmī; / it should be performed here with effort, producing eloquence of speech.

4.121.s:
naktamannaṃ caritvā tu gavā sārddhaṃ kuṭuṃbine ..
haimaṃ cakraṃ triśūlaṃ ca dadyādviprāya vāsasī.. 12 ..
4.121.d:
नक्तमन्नं चरित्वा तु गवा सार्द्धं कुटुंबिने ॥
हैमं चक्रं त्रिशूलं च दद्याद्विप्राय वाससी॥ 12 ॥
4.121.m: Having observed [the vow of] food at night, to a householder together with a cow / one should give a golden disc and trident, and two garments to a brāhmaṇa.

4.121.s:
praṇamya bhaktyā deveśau prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau ..
etadevavrataṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam ..13..
4.121.d:
प्रणम्य भक्त्या देवेशौ प्रीयेतां शिवकेशवौ ॥
एतदेवव्रतं नाम महापातकनाशनम् ॥13॥
4.121.m: Bowing with devotion: “May Śiva and Keśava, lords of the gods, be pleased!” / This is named the Devavrata, destroying major sins.

4.121.s:
kṛtvaikabhuktaṃ varṣāṃte śaktyā haimavṛṣānvitām ..
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyātsarvo paskaraṇairyutām .. 14 ..
4.121.d:
कृत्वैकभुक्तं वर्षांते शक्त्या हैमवृषान्विताम् ॥
धेनुं तिलमयीं दद्यात्सर्वो पस्करणैर्युताम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.121.m: Having eaten a single meal, at the end of the year, according to one's capacity, / one should give a cow made of sesame seeds accompanied by a golden bull and all utensils.

4.121.s:
etadrudravrataṃ nāma pāpaśokapraṇāśanam ..
yaḥ karoti pumānrājansa padaṃ yāti śāṃkaram .. 15 ..
4.121.d:
एतद्रुद्रव्रतं नाम पापशोकप्रणाशनम् ॥
यः करोति पुमान्राजन्स पदं याति शांकरम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.121.m: This is named the Rudravrata, destroying sin and sorrow; / the man who performs it, O king, goes to the abode of Śaṅkara.

4.121.s:
sarvauṣadhyudakasnātaḥ pañcamyāṃ pūjya paṃcakam ..
saptopaskaradānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti gṛhāśramī .. 16 ..
4.121.d:
सर्वौषध्युदकस्नातः पञ्चम्यां पूज्य पंचकम् ॥
सप्तोपस्करदानं च यः करोति गृहाश्रमी ॥ 16 ॥
4.121.m: Bathed in water [infused with] all medicinal herbs, having worshipped the five on the fifth lunar day, / whichever householder makes the gift of seven household utensils:

4.121.s:
gṛhādyulūkhalaṃ śūrpaḥ śilā sthālī ca pañcamī ..
udakuṃbhaśca cullī ca eteṣāmanukiñcana.. 17 ..
4.121.d:
गृहाद्युलूखलं शूर्पः शिला स्थाली च पञ्चमी ॥
उदकुंभश्च चुल्ली च एतेषामनुकिञ्चन॥ 17 ॥
4.121.m: a house and so on, a mortar, a winnowing basket, a grindstone, a pot as the fifth, / a water jar, and a hearth—whatever belongs to these—

4.121.s:
etāni gṛhiṇāṃ gehe prasthāpya puruṣottamam ..
upaskaroti yā nārī na sīdati kadācana .. 18 ..
4.121.d:
एतानि गृहिणां गेहे प्रस्थाप्य पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
उपस्करोति या नारी न सीदति कदाचन ॥ 18 ॥
4.121.m: whichever woman sets these up in the homes of householders, / establishes Puruṣottama, and provides the utensils, never languishes.

4.121.s:
etadgṛhavrataṃ nāma sarva saukhyapradāyakam..
atriṇā hyanasūyāyāḥ kathitaṃ pāṇḍunandana .. 19 ..
4.121.d:
एतद्गृहव्रतं नाम सर्व सौख्यप्रदायकम्॥
अत्रिणा ह्यनसूयायाः कथितं पाण्डुनन्दन ॥ 19 ॥
4.121.m: This is named the Gṛhavrata, granting all happiness; / it was told indeed to Anasūyā by Atri, O joy of the Pāṇḍavas.

4.121.s:
yastu nīlotpalaṃ haimaṃ śarkarāpātrasaṃyutam ..
dadāti śraddhayopeto brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine .. 4.121.20 ..
4.121.d:
यस्तु नीलोत्पलं हैमं शर्करापात्रसंयुतम् ॥
ददाति श्रद्धयोपेतो ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥ 4.121.20 ॥
4.121.m: Whoever, endowed with faith, gives a golden blue lotus / accompanied by a vessel of sugar to a brāhmaṇa householder,

4.121.s:
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti līlāvratamidaṃ smṛtam ..
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsamabhyaṃgaṃ varjayennaraḥ .. 21 ..
4.121.d:
स वैष्णवं पदं याति लीलाव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् ॥
आषाढादिचतुर्मासमभ्यंगं वर्जयेन्नरः ॥ 21 ॥
4.121.m: he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu; this is remembered as the Līlāvrata. / A man should avoid oil-massage for the four months beginning with Āṣāḍha;

4.121.s:
pārite ca punardadyāttilatailaghaṭaṃ navam ..
bhojanaṃ pāyasājyaṃ ca sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ ..22..
4.121.d:
पारिते च पुनर्दद्यात्तिलतैलघटं नवम् ॥
भोजनं पायसाज्यं च स याति भवनं हरेः ॥22॥
4.121.m: and when the fast is broken, he should give a new jar of sesame oil / and food of milk-rice with ghee; he goes to the abode of Hari.

4.121.s:
lokaprītikaraṃ caitatprītivratamihocyate ..
varjayitvā madhau yastu dadhikṣīraghṛtaikṣavam .. .. 23 ..
4.121.d:
लोकप्रीतिकरं चैतत्प्रीतिव्रतमिहोच्यते ॥
वर्जयित्वा मधौ यस्तु दधिक्षीरघृतैक्षवम् ॥ ॥ 23 ॥
4.121.m: It produces the affection of the world, and is called here the Prītivrata. / Whoever avoids curd, milk, ghee, and sugarcane juice in Madhu,

4.121.s:
dadyādvastrayugaṃ sūkṣmaṃ rasapātraiśca saṃyutam ..
saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ gaurī me prīyatāmiti .. 24 ..
4.121.d:
दद्याद्वस्त्रयुगं सूक्ष्मं रसपात्रैश्च संयुतम् ॥
संपूज्य विप्रमिथुनं गौरी मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 24 ॥
4.121.m: and gives a fine pair of garments together with vessels of liquids, / having worshipped a brāhmaṇa couple, saying, “May Gaurī be pleased with me!”—

4.121.s:
etadgaurīvrataṃ nāma bhavānīloka dāyakam ..
puruṣo yastrayodaśyāṃ kṛtvā naktamatho punaḥ .. 25 ..
4.121.d:
एतद्गौरीव्रतं नाम भवानीलोक दायकम् ॥
पुरुषो यस्त्रयोदश्यां कृत्वा नक्तमथो पुनः ॥ 25 ॥
4.121.m: this is named the Gaurīvrata, granting the realm of Bhavānī. / A man who, having eaten at night on the thirteenth lunar day, then

4.121.s:
saṃvatsarāṃte tasminvā divase vighnavarjitam ..
aśokakāṃcanaṃ dadyātsadvastrayugasaṃśritam .. 26 ..
4.121.d:
संवत्सरांते तस्मिन्वा दिवसे विघ्नवर्जितम् ॥
अशोककांचनं दद्यात्सद्वस्त्रयुगसंश्रितम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.121.m: at the end of the year or on that very day, free from obstacles, / gives an aśoka [blossom] of gold provided with a good pair of garments

4.121.s:
viprāya vasusaṃyuktaṃ pradyumnaḥ prīyatāmiti ..
kalpaṃ viṣṇupade sthitvā viśokaḥ syātpunarnṛpa .. 27 ..
4.121.d:
विप्राय वसुसंयुक्तं प्रद्युम्नः प्रीयतामिति ॥
कल्पं विष्णुपदे स्थित्वा विशोकः स्यात्पुनर्नृप ॥ 27 ॥
4.121.m: to a brāhmaṇa together with wealth, saying, “May Pradyumna be pleased!” / having stayed in the realm of Viṣṇu for an eon, he becomes free from sorrow, O king.

4.121.s:
etatkāmavrataṃnāma sarvaśokavināśanam ..
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsaṃ varjayennakhakartanam .. 28 ..
4.121.d:
एतत्कामव्रतंनाम सर्वशोकविनाशनम् ॥
आषाढादिचतुर्मासं वर्जयेन्नखकर्तनम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.121.m: This is named the Kāmavrata, destroying all sorrow. / One should avoid cutting the nails for the four months beginning with Āṣāḍha,

4.121.s:
vṛṃtākabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhusarpirghaṭānvitam ..
kārtikyāṃ tu punarhaimaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 29 ..
4.121.d:
वृंताकभक्षणं चैव मधुसर्पिर्घटान्वितम् ॥
कार्तिक्यां तु पुनर्हैमं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.121.m: and the eating of aubergine; and on the Kārttika full moon, / one should present to a brāhmaṇa a golden [image] along with a jar of honey and ghee.

4.121.s:
rudralokamavāpnoti śivavratamidaṃ smṛtam ..
evaṃ pañcadaśīṃ smṛtvā ekabhaktena mānavaḥ .. 4.121.30 ..
4.121.d:
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति शिवव्रतमिदं स्मृतम् ॥
एवं पञ्चदशीं स्मृत्वा एकभक्तेन मानवः ॥ 4.121.30 ॥
4.121.m: He attains the realm of Rudra; this is remembered as the Śivavrata. / Thus a person, mindful on the fifteenth lunar day, eating a single meal,

4.121.s:
saṃpūjya pūrṇimāṃ devīṃ likhitvā candanādinā ..
tataḥ pañcaghaṭānpūrṇānpayodadhighṛtena ca ..
madhunā sitakhaṇḍena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 31 ..
4.121.d:
संपूज्य पूर्णिमां देवीं लिखित्वा चन्दनादिना ॥
ततः पञ्चघटान्पूर्णान्पयोदधिघृतेन च ॥
मधुना सितखण्डेन ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.121.m: having worshipped the goddess of the full moon after drawing [her] with sandalwood paste and the like, / should then present to a brāhmaṇa five jars filled with milk, curd, and ghee, / with honey and white sugar:

4.121.s:
manorathānpūrayasva saṃpūrṇānpūrṇimā hyasi ..
pañcakumbhapradānena bhūtānāṃ tuṣṭirastu me ..
dvijānevaṃ namaskṛtya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
4.121.d:
मनोरथान्पूरयस्व संपूर्णान्पूर्णिमा ह्यसि ॥
पञ्चकुम्भप्रदानेन भूतानां तुष्टिरस्तु मे ॥
द्विजानेवं नमस्कृत्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 32 ॥
4.121.m: “Fulfill my desires completely, for you are the full moon! / May the beings be pleased with me through the gift of five water jars!” / Having thus bowed to the twice-born, he would obtain all desires.

4.121.s:
etatpaṃcaghaṭaṃ nāma vrataṃ puṣṭipradāyakam...
varjayedyastu puṣpāṇi hemaṃtaśiśirāvratam .. 33 ..
4.121.d:
एतत्पंचघटं नाम व्रतं पुष्टिप्रदायकम्॥।
वर्जयेद्यस्तु पुष्पाणि हेमंतशिशिराव्रतम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.121.m: This is named the Pañcaghaṭavrata, granting nourishment. / Whoever avoids flowers throughout the winter and cool seasons,

4.121.s:
puṣpatrayaṃ ca phālgunyāṃ kṛtvā śaktyātha kāñcanam ..
dadyādvai kālavelāyāṃ prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau .. .. 34 ..
4.121.d:
पुष्पत्रयं च फाल्गुन्यां कृत्वा शक्त्याथ काञ्चनम् ॥
दद्याद्वै कालवेलायां प्रीयेतां शिवकेशवौ ॥ ॥ 34 ॥
4.121.m: and on the full moon of Phālguna, according to his capacity, having made three golden flowers, / gives [them] at the twilight hour: “May Śiva and Keśava be pleased!”

4.121.s:
śiraḥsaugandhajananaṃ sadānandakaraṃ nṛṇām ..
kṛtvā parapadaṃ yāti saugandhyavratamuttamam .. 35 ..
4.121.d:
शिरःसौगन्धजननं सदानन्दकरं नृणाम् ॥
कृत्वा परपदं याति सौगन्ध्यव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.121.m: It produces fragrance of the head and brings perpetual delight to mortals; / having performed this excellent Saugandhyavrata, he goes to the supreme abode.

4.121.s:
phālgunāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yastu varjayet ..
samāpte śayanaṃ dayādgṛhe copaskarānvitam .. 36 ..
4.121.d:
फाल्गुनादितृतीयायां लवणं यस्तु वर्जयेत् ॥
समाप्ते शयनं दयाद्गृहे चोपस्करान्वितम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.121.m: Whoever avoids salt on the third lunar day beginning with Phālguna, / and at the completion gives a bed in a house supplied with utensils,

4.121.s:
saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti ..
gaurīloke vasetkalpaṃ saubhāgyavratamutta mam .. 37 ..
4.121.d:
संपूज्य विप्रमिथुनं भवानी प्रीयतामिति ॥
गौरीलोके वसेत्कल्पं सौभाग्यव्रतमुत्त मम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.121.m: having worshipped a brāhmaṇa couple, saying, “May Bhavānī be pleased!” / would dwell in the realm of Gaurī for an eon; this is the excellent Saubhāgyavrata.

4.121.s:
saṃdhyāmaunaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā samāpte ghṛtakuṃbhadaḥ ..
vastrayugmaṃ ca ghaṃṭāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 38 ..
4.121.d:
संध्यामौनं नरः कृत्वा समाप्ते घृतकुंभदः ॥
वस्त्रयुग्मं च घंटां च ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.121.m: A man, observing silence at twilight, at its completion gives a jar of ghee, / and presents a pair of garments and a bell to a brāhmaṇa;

4.121.s:
sārasvataṃ padaṃ yāti punarāvṛtti durlabham..
etatsārasvataṃ nāma rūpavidyāpradāyakam .. 39 ..
4.121.d:
सारस्वतं पदं याति पुनरावृत्ति दुर्लभम्॥
एतत्सारस्वतं नाम रूपविद्याप्रदायकम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.121.m: he goes to the realm of Sarasvatī, from which return is hard to obtain. / This is named the Sārasvata[vrata], granting beauty and learning.

4.121.s:
lakṣmīmadhye'tha pañcamyāmupavāsī bhavennaraḥ ..
samāpte hemakamalaṃ dadyāddhenusamanvitam .. .. 4.121.40 ..
4.121.d:
लक्ष्मीमध्येऽथ पञ्चम्यामुपवासी भवेन्नरः ॥
समाप्ते हेमकमलं दद्याद्धेनुसमन्वितम् ॥ ॥ 4.121.40 ॥
4.121.m: A man should fast on the fifth lunar day in the midst of Lakṣmī; / at the completion, he should give a golden lotus accompanied by a cow.

4.121.s:
sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti lakṣmīḥ syājjanmajanmani ..
etallakṣmīvrataṃ nāma duḥkhaśokavināśanam ..41..
4.121.d:
स वैष्णवं पदं याति लक्ष्मीः स्याज्जन्मजन्मनि ॥
एतल्लक्ष्मीव्रतं नाम दुःखशोकविनाशनम् ॥41॥
4.121.m: He goes to the realm of Viṣṇu, and fortune attends him in birth after birth; / this is named the Lakṣmīvrata, destroying grief and sorrow.

4.121.s:
yā tu nārī pibettoyaṃ jaladhārāṃ prapātayet ..
samāptaghṛtasaṃpūrṇāṃ dadyādvadvaṃtikāṃ? navām ..42 ..
4.121.d:
या तु नारी पिबेत्तोयं जलधारां प्रपातयेत् ॥
समाप्तघृतसंपूर्णां दद्याद्वद्वंतिकां? नवाम् ॥42 ॥
4.121.m: A woman who, drinking water, causes a stream of water to pour down, / at its completion should give a new vessel filled with ghee.

4.121.s:
etaddhārāvrataṃ nāma sarvarogaharaṃ param..
kāṃtisaubhāgyajananaṃ sapatnīdarpanāśanam..43..
4.121.d:
एतद्धाराव्रतं नाम सर्वरोगहरं परम्॥
कांतिसौभाग्यजननं सपत्नीदर्पनाशनम्॥43॥
4.121.m: This is named the Dhārāvrata, supreme, dispelling all diseases, / producing radiance and good fortune, destroying the arrogance of co-wives.

4.121.s:
gaurīsamanvitaṃ rudraṃ lakṣmyā saha janārdanam ..
rājñīsamanvitaṃ sūryaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi .. 44 ..
4.121.d:
गौरीसमन्वितं रुद्रं लक्ष्म्या सह जनार्दनम् ॥
राज्ञीसमन्वितं सूर्यं प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि ॥ 44 ॥
4.121.m: Having duly established Rudra accompanied by Gaurī, Janārdana with Lakṣmī, / and Sūrya accompanied by Rājñī,

4.121.s:
dhūpākṣepeṇasahitāṃ sughaṃṭāṃ pātrasaṃyutām ..
yo dadāti dvijendrāṇāṃ puṣpairabhyarcya pāṃḍuraiḥ .. 45 ..
4.121.d:
धूपाक्षेपेणसहितां सुघंटां पात्रसंयुताम् ॥
यो ददाति द्विजेन्द्राणां पुष्पैरभ्यर्च्य पांडुरैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.121.m: whoever gives to the best of twice-born a fine bell along with a vessel, accompanied by the offering of incense, / having worshipped with white flowers,

4.121.s:
dakṣiṇāsahitāṃ kṛtvā praṇamya ca visarjayet ..
etaddevavrataṃ nāma divyadehapradāyakam .. 46 ..
4.121.d:
दक्षिणासहितां कृत्वा प्रणम्य च विसर्जयेत् ॥
एतद्देवव्रतं नाम दिव्यदेहप्रदायकम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.121.m: having provided a sacrificial fee and having bowed, sends [them] away; / this is named the Devavrata, granting a celestial body.

4.121.s:
kṛtvopalepanaṃ śaṃbhoragrataḥ keśavasya ca ..
yāvadvrataṃ samāpyaitaddhenuṃ ca sajalānvitām .. 47 ..
4.121.d:
कृत्वोपलेपनं शंभोरग्रतः केशवस्य च ॥
यावद्व्रतं समाप्यैतद्धेनुं च सजलान्विताम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.121.m: Having performed plastering in front of Śambhu and Keśava, / as long as this votive observance lasts, and [giving] a cow along with water,

4.121.s:
janmāyutaṃ sa rājā syāttataḥ śivapuraṃ vaset ..
etacchrutvā vrataṃ nāma bahukalyāṇakārakam .. 48 ..
4.121.d:
जन्मायुतं स राजा स्यात्ततः शिवपुरं वसेत् ॥
एतच्छ्रुत्वा व्रतं नाम बहुकल्याणकारकम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.121.m: He shall become a king for ten thousand births; then he shall dwell in the city of Śiva. / Having heard this, it is an observance named [Devavrata] that brings abundant welfare.

4.121.s:
aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamyaiva ca vāgyataḥ ..
ekabhuktaṃ naraḥ kuryādaṣṭa caikaṃ vimatsaraḥ .. 49 ...
4.121.d:
अश्वत्थं भास्करं गंगां प्रणम्यैव च वाग्यतः ॥
एकभुक्तं नरः कुर्यादष्ट चैकं विमत्सरः ॥ 49 ॥।
4.121.m: Bowing to the holy fig tree, the sun, and the Gaṅgā, with tongue controlled, / a man free from envy should eat only one single meal a day for eight [months].

4.121.s:
vratāṃte vipramithunaṃ pūjya dhenutrayānvitam ..
vṛkṣaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ dadyātsośvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 4.121.50 ..
4.121.d:
व्रतांते विप्रमिथुनं पूज्य धेनुत्रयान्वितम् ॥
वृक्षं हिरण्मयं दद्यात्सोश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥ 4.121.50 ॥
4.121.m: At the end of the votive observance, having worshipped a brahmin couple along with three cows, / he should give a golden tree; he obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha sacrifice.

4.121.s:
divi divyavimānasthaḥ sevyate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ...
etatkīrtivrataṃ nāma bhūtikīrtiphalapradam ..51..
4.121.d:
दिवि दिव्यविमानस्थः सेव्यतेऽप्सरसां गणैः॥।
एतत्कीर्तिव्रतं नाम भूतिकीर्तिफलप्रदम् ॥51॥
4.121.m: Seated in a celestial chariot in heaven, he is served by hosts of apsarases. / This is an observance named Kīrtivrata, which bestows prosperity and fame as its fruit.

4.121.s:
ghṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhorvā keśavasya ca ..
brāhmaṇo bhāskarasyāpi gauryā laṃbodarasya vā.. 52..
4.121.d:
घृतेन स्नपनं कृत्वा शंभोर्वा केशवस्य च ॥
ब्राह्मणो भास्करस्यापि गौर्या लंबोदरस्य वा॥ 52॥
4.121.m: Having bathed with ghee either Śambhu, Keśava, / the sun, Gaurī, or Lambodara, a brahmin

4.121.s:
akṣataistu samaṃ kuryātpadmaṃ gomayamaṇḍale ..
samāpya hemakamalaṃ tiladhenusamanvitam .. 53 ..
4.121.d:
अक्षतैस्तु समं कुर्यात्पद्मं गोमयमण्डले ॥
समाप्य हेमकमलं तिलधेनुसमन्वितम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.121.m: should make a lotus of whole grains on a cow-dung circle. / Having completed [the rite], a golden lotus together with a sesame cow,

4.121.s:
śuddhamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ dayācchivaloke mahīyate ..
sāmagāyanataścaitatsāmavratamihocyate .. 54 ..
4.121.d:
शुद्धमष्टाङ्गुलं दयाच्छिवलोके महीयते ॥
सामगायनतश्चैतत्सामव्रतमिहोच्यते ॥ 54 ॥
4.121.m: pure, eight finger-breadths in size, he should give away; he is glorified in the world of Śiva. / Because of the singing of the Sāmaveda hymns, this is called here the Sāmavrata.

4.121.s:
navamyāmekabhuktaṃ tu kṛtvā kanyāśca śaktitaḥ ..
bhojayitvā samādadyāddhaimakaṃcukavāsasī .. 55 ..
4.121.d:
नवम्यामेकभुक्तं तु कृत्वा कन्याश्च शक्तितः ॥
