4.128.m: On the previous day he should perform preliminary consecration upon the tree adorned with flags; / covering it with red garments, he should bind it with a red thread.

4.128.s:
piṣṭātakenāvakiretsarvauṣadhyā ca pādapam ..
sthāpayetpūrṇakalaśāṃścaturdikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 24 ..
4.128.d:
पिष्टातकेनावकिरेत्सर्वौषध्या च पादपम् ॥
स्थापयेत्पूर्णकलशांश्चतुर्दिक्षु विचक्षणः ॥ 24 ॥
4.128.m: He should sprinkle the tree with fragrant cosmetic powder and all herbs; / the wise man should set down full water-jars in the four directions,

4.128.s:
pallavālaṃkṛtamukhānsitacandanacarcitān ..
sitavāsoyugacchannānsakalānratnagarbhiṇaḥ .. 25 ..
4.128.d:
पल्लवालंकृतमुखान्सितचन्दनचर्चितान् ॥
सितवासोयुगच्छन्नान्सकलान्रत्नगर्भिणः ॥ 25 ॥
4.128.m: their mouths adorned with shoots, smeared with white sandalwood, / draped with a pair of white cloths, complete and containing jewels inside.

4.128.s:
patākālaṃkṛtāḥ sarve kāryāstatsannidhau drumāḥ ..
mūlavinyastakalaśā raktasūtrāvaguṇṭhitāḥ .. 26 ..
4.128.d:
पताकालंकृताः सर्वे कार्यास्तत्सन्निधौ द्रुमाः ॥
मूलविन्यस्तकलशा रक्तसूत्रावगुण्ठिताः ॥ 26 ॥
4.128.m: All the trees near it must be adorned with flags, / jars placed at their roots, veiled with red threads,

4.128.s:
raktapītasitācchādaiścarcitāḥ sumanoharaiḥ ..
kaladhautamayānyatra phalāni daśa paṃca vā .. 27 ..
4.128.d:
रक्तपीतसिताच्छादैश्चर्चिताः सुमनोहरैः ॥
कलधौतमयान्यत्र फलानि दश पंच वा ॥ 27 ॥
4.128.m: anointed, [draped] with highly charming red, yellow, and white coverings; / there [he should prepare] ten or five fruits made of gold

4.128.s:
tāmrapātryāṃ sabījāni saralānyadhivāsayet ..
tūryamaṅgalaghoṣeṇa caturdikṣu kṣipedbalim .. 28 ..
4.128.d:
ताम्रपात्र्यां सबीजानि सरलान्यधिवासयेत् ॥
तूर्यमङ्गलघोषेण चतुर्दिक्षु क्षिपेद्बलिम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.128.m: and consecrate them, straight and containing seeds, in a copper vessel. / To the sound of musical instruments and auspicious chants he should cast the offering in the four directions

4.128.s:
indrādilokapālebhyo bhūtebhyo maṃtravidguruḥ ..
tataḥ prabhāte vimale kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā samekhalam .. 29 ..
4.128.d:
इन्द्रादिलोकपालेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो मंत्रविद्गुरुः ॥
ततः प्रभाते विमले कुंडं कृत्वा समेखलम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.128.m: to the world protectors headed by Indra and to the ghosts, the guru knowing the mantras. / Then, at clear dawn, having constructed a sacrificial pit with girdles,

4.128.s:
grahayajñavidhānena śāṃtikarma samārabhet ..
suvarṇālaṃkṛtānkṛtvā brāhmaṇānvedapāragān .. 4.128.30 ..
4.128.d:
ग्रहयज्ञविधानेन शांतिकर्म समारभेत् ॥
सुवर्णालंकृतान्कृत्वा ब्राह्मणान्वेदपारगान् ॥ 4.128.30 ॥
4.128.m: he should commence the rite of pacification according to the rules of planetary sacrifice, / having adorned with gold brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas.

4.128.s:
caturo'ṣṭau yathāśaktyā vāsobhirabhipūjayet ..
tilājyena ca homaḥ syāttuṣṭipuṣṭikaraḥ sadā .. 31 ..
4.128.d:
चतुरोऽष्टौ यथाशक्त्या वासोभिरभिपूजयेत् ॥
तिलाज्येन च होमः स्यात्तुष्टिपुष्टिकरः सदा ॥ 31 ॥
4.128.m: According to his capacity he should honour four or eight with garments, / and the oblation should be made with sesame and ghee, always bringing contentment and prosperity.

4.128.s:
mātaraṃ sthāpayitvāgre pūjayetkusumākṣataiḥ ..
śrapayitvā caruṃ samyakpāyasādyapariplutam .. 32 ..
4.128.d:
मातरं स्थापयित्वाग्रे पूजयेत्कुसुमाक्षतैः ॥
श्रपयित्वा चरुं सम्यक्पायसाद्यपरिप्लुतम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.128.m: Having placed the Mother in front, he should worship her with flowers and unbroken grains, / having properly cooked the sacrificial porridge steeped in milk-rice and other delicacies.

4.128.s:
homādau jātakarmādi godānaṃ yāvadeva tu ..
pādapaṃ snāpayitvā tu samaṃtraistīrthavāribhiḥ..33..
4.128.d:
होमादौ जातकर्मादि गोदानं यावदेव तु ॥
पादपं स्नापयित्वा तु समंत्रैस्तीर्थवारिभिः॥33॥
4.128.m: Beginning with the fire offering, the birth rites up through the gift of a cow [should be done]; / having bathed the tree with consecrated waters from sacred places,

4.128.s:
jātakaṃ nāmakaraṇamannaprāśanameva ca ..
suvarṇasūcyā kurvīta karṇavedhaṃ vidhānavit .. 34 ..
4.128.d:
जातकं नामकरणमन्नप्राशनमेव च ॥
सुवर्णसूच्या कुर्वीत कर्णवेधं विधानवित् ॥ 34 ॥
4.128.m: the birth rite, the naming ceremony, and the first feeding of solid food; / the one who knows the ritual should perform the ear-piercing with a golden needle.

4.128.s:
jātarūpakṣureṇātra cūḍākāryā yathākramam ..
badhnīyānmekhalāṃ mauñjīṃ vāsaśca paridhāpayet .. 35 ..
4.128.d:
जातरूपक्षुरेणात्र चूडाकार्या यथाक्रमम् ॥
बध्नीयान्मेखलां मौञ्जीं वासश्च परिधापयेत् ॥ 35 ॥
4.128.m: Here the tonsure is to be performed in proper order with a golden razor; / he should tie a girdle of muñja grass and clothe it in a garment.

4.128.s:
yajamānastataḥ snātaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ..
puṣpāñjaliḥ samabhyetya maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 36 ..
4.128.d:
यजमानस्ततः स्नातः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ॥
पुष्पाञ्जलिः समभ्येत्य मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 36 ॥
4.128.m: Then the sacrificer, bathed, wearing white garments, pure, / with folded hands holding flowers, having approached, should utter this mantra:

4.128.s:
ye śākhinaḥ śikhariṇāṃ śirasā vibhūṣā ye nandanādiṣu vaneṣu kṛtapratiṣṭhāḥ ..
ye kāmadāḥ suranaroragakinnarāṇāṃ te me natasya duritārtiharā bhavaṃtu ... 37 ..
4.128.d:
ये शाखिनः शिखरिणां शिरसा विभूषा ये नन्दनादिषु वनेषु कृतप्रतिष्ठाः ॥
ये कामदाः सुरनरोरगकिन्नराणां ते मे नतस्य दुरितार्तिहरा भवंतु ॥। 37 ॥
4.128.m: "May those trees that are ornaments upon the crest of mountains, those established in forests such as Nandana, / those that grant wishes to gods, mortals, serpents, and kinnaras, remove sins and afflictions for me who bow down [to them].

4.128.s:
etairdvijairvidhivaraprahuto hutāśaḥ paśyatyasāvahimadīdhitiraṃbarasthaḥ ..
tvaṃ vṛkṣa putraparikalpanayā vṛto'si kāryaṃ sadaiva bhavatā mama putrakāryam .. 38 ..
4.128.d:
एतैर्द्विजैर्विधिवरप्रहुतो हुताशः पश्यत्यसावहिमदीधितिरंबरस्थः ॥
त्वं वृक्ष पुत्रपरिकल्पनया वृतोऽसि कार्यं सदैव भवता मम पुत्रकार्यम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.128.m: By these twice-born the fire is offered with excellent rites; the hot-rayed [sun] standing in the sky watches. / You, O tree, have been chosen in the conception of a son; you must always perform for me the duties of a son."

4.128.s:
ityevamuktvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ lālayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ..
ghṛtapātre svavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvāśiṣamudīrayet .. 39 ..
4.128.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा तं वृक्षं लालयित्वा पुनःपुनः ॥
घृतपात्रे स्ववदनं दृष्ट्वाशिषमुदीरयेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.128.m: Having spoken thus, cherishing that tree again and again, / looking at his own face in a vessel of ghee, he should utter the blessing:

4.128.s:
aṅgādaṅgātsaṃbhavasi hṛdayādabhijāyase ..
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradaḥ śatam .. 4.128.40 ..
4.128.d:
अङ्गादङ्गात्संभवसि हृदयादभिजायसे ॥
आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि स जीव शरदः शतम् ॥ 4.128.40 ॥
4.128.m: "You are produced from limb after limb; you are born from the heart. / You are indeed the self named 'son'; live for a hundred autumns!"

4.128.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tato deyā dakṣiṇā hṛṣṭamānasaiḥ ..
sthāpakāya śubhāṃ dhenuṃ dattvā kuryānmahotsavam .. 41 ..
4.128.d:
ब्राह्मणानां ततो देया दक्षिणा हृष्टमानसैः ॥
स्थापकाय शुभां धेनुं दत्त्वा कुर्यान्महोत्सवम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.128.m: Then a priestly fee should be given to the brāhmaṇas with joyful hearts; / having given an auspicious cow to the master of ceremonies, he should hold a great festival.

4.128.s:
dīnānāthajanānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cānivāritam ..
itareṣāṃ pradātavyaṃ saṃtuṣṭena surāsavam .. 42 ..
4.128.d:
दीनानाथजनानां च भोजनं चानिवारितम् ॥
इतरेषां प्रदातव्यं संतुष्टेन सुरासवम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.128.m: Food is to be given without restriction to the poor and helpless people, / and spirituous liquor should be given by the contented man to the others.

4.128.s:
jñātibandhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ ..
preṣyāḥ karmakarāḥ sarve pūjanīyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ .. 43 ..
4.128.d:
ज्ञातिबन्धुजनैः सार्द्धं स्वयं भुञ्जीत कामतः ॥
प्रेष्याः कर्मकराः सर्वे पूजनीयाः स्वशक्तितः ॥ 43 ॥
4.128.m: Together with his kinsmen and relatives he should himself eat at will; / all attendants and servants should be honoured according to his capacity.

4.128.s:
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha vṛkṣāṇāṃ mahadutsavam ..
sarvakāmānavāpnoti ihaloke paratra ca .. 44 ..
4.128.d:
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ वृक्षाणां महदुत्सवम् ॥
सर्वकामानवाप्नोति इहलोके परत्र च ॥ 44 ॥
4.128.m: Whoever performs such a great festival of trees, O Pārtha, / obtains all desires in this world and in the next.

4.128.s:
putrairvinā śubhagatirna bhavennarāṇāṃ duṣputrakairiti tathobhayalokanāśaḥ ..
etadvicārya sudhiyā paripālya vṛkṣānputrāḥ purāṇavidhinā parikalpanīyā .. 45 ..
devapūjāvidhivarṇanam
4.128.d:
पुत्रैर्विना शुभगतिर्न भवेन्नराणां दुष्पुत्रकैरिति तथोभयलोकनाशः ॥
एतद्विचार्य सुधिया परिपाल्य वृक्षान्पुत्राः पुराणविधिना परिकल्पनीया ॥ 45 ॥
देवपूजाविधिवर्णनम्
4.128.m:
Without sons there is no auspicious destiny for men; and through bad sons there is destruction in both worlds. / Considering this, having nurtured trees with a wise mind, they should be conceived as sons according to the ancient rule.
Description of the Rules for Worshipping Deities

4.129.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ye mānavāstridaśamūrtiniketanāni kurvaṃti sādhujanadṛṣṭimanoharāṇi ..
teṣāṃ mṛte'tha paramārthamaye śarīre loke paribhramati kīrtimayaṃ śarīram .. 1 ..
4.129.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
ये मानवास्त्रिदशमूर्तिनिकेतनानि कुर्वंति साधुजनदृष्टिमनोहराणि ॥
तेषां मृतेऽथ परमार्थमये शरीरे लोके परिभ्रमति कीर्तिमयं शरीरम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.129.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Those men who build dwellings for the forms of the gods, pleasing to the eyes of good people, / after their physical body dies, their body composed of renown wanders throughout the world.

4.129.s:
yaḥ kārayeddvārasitābhragauramuttuṃgasaudhadhavalāyatanaṃ surāṇām ..
caṃdrāvadātabhavane divi labdhasaukhyo rājyaśriyaṃ sa bhuvi bodhayutāmupaiti .. 2 ..
4.129.d:
यः कारयेद्द्वारसिताभ्रगौरमुत्तुंगसौधधवलायतनं सुराणाम् ॥
चंद्रावदातभवने दिवि लब्धसौख्यो राज्यश्रियं स भुवि बोधयुतामुपैति ॥ 2 ॥
4.129.m: Whoever causes to be built an abode for the gods, lofty, white with mansions, and pale as white clouds at the gateway, / finding happiness in heaven in an abode pure as the moon, attains sovereign fortune endowed with wisdom on earth.

4.129.s:
ye kārayaṃti surasadmasu devatānāmarcāḥ suvarṇarajatāyasaśailatāmrāḥ ..
sāmaṃtamaulimaṇiraśmisamamarcitāste siṃhāsane'ṅgadakirīṭabhṛto'vabhāṃti .. 3 ..
4.129.d:
ये कारयंति सुरसद्मसु देवतानामर्चाः सुवर्णरजतायसशैलताम्राः ॥
सामंतमौलिमणिरश्मिसममर्चितास्ते सिंहासनेऽङ्गदकिरीटभृतोऽवभांति ॥ 3 ॥
4.129.m: Those who cause images of deities to be made in the houses of the gods, out of gold, silver, iron, stone, and copper, / honoured by the radiant gems of the diadems of feudatories, shine upon a throne, bearing armlets and crowns.

4.129.s:
ye merumaulisurasaṃghakṛtābhiṣekāḥ pañcāmṛtaiḥ suravarānabhiṣecayaṃti ..
te divyakalpamabhidhārya sureśvaratvaṃ rājyābhiṣekamatulaṃ punarāpnuvaṃti .. 4 ..
4.129.d:
ये मेरुमौलिसुरसंघकृताभिषेकाः पञ्चामृतैः सुरवरानभिषेचयंति ॥
ते दिव्यकल्पमभिधार्य सुरेश्वरत्वं राज्याभिषेकमतुलं पुनराप्नुवंति ॥ 4 ॥
4.129.m: Those who bathe the foremost gods with the five nectars, like the bathing performed by the host of gods upon the summit of Meru, / having assumed divine sovereignty over the gods for a divine cosmic age, attain matchless royal consecration again.

4.129.s:
ye śailarājamalayodbhavacaṃdanena satkuṃkumena ca surānanulepayaṃti ..
te divyagandhapaṭavāsasugaṃdhidehā naṃdaṃti naṃdanavaneṣu sahāpsarobhiḥ .. 5 ..
4.129.d:
ये शैलराजमलयोद्भवचंदनेन सत्कुंकुमेन च सुराननुलेपयंति ॥
ते दिव्यगन्धपटवाससुगंधिदेहा नंदंति नंदनवनेषु सहाप्सरोभिः ॥ 5 ॥
4.129.m: Those who anoint the gods with sandalwood born from the king of mountains and Malaya, and with genuine saffron, / their bodies fragrant with divine perfumes and scented powders, rejoice in the Nandana groves together with apsarases.

4.129.s:
gaṃdhāḍhyajātikamalotpaladivyapuṣpairdevānnavairanudinaṃ nanu ye'rcayaṃti ..
puṣpottamairnarapatitvamavāpya te'pi yāsyaṃti kuṃdadhavalāmacireṇa siddhim .. 6 ..
4.129.d:
गंधाढ्यजातिकमलोत्पलदिव्यपुष्पैर्देवान्नवैरनुदिनं ननु येऽर्चयंति ॥
पुष्पोत्तमैर्नरपतित्वमवाप्य तेऽपि यास्यंति कुंदधवलामचिरेण सिद्धिम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.129.m: Those who surely worship the gods every day with fresh, excellent flowers, fragrant jasmine, lotuses, blue water-lilies, and divine blossoms, / having obtained kingship through the best of flowers, they too will soon attain success pure as the jasmine flower.

4.129.s:
āmodibhirhimaturuṣkasugandhadhūpairye mānavāḥ suravarānapi dhūpayaṃti ..
karpūradhāranibhagandhavarā bhirāme svarge vimānavati te bhavane ramaṃte .. 7 ..
4.129.d:
आमोदिभिर्हिमतुरुष्कसुगन्धधूपैर्ये मानवाः सुरवरानपि धूपयंति ॥
कर्पूरधारनिभगन्धवरा भिरामे स्वर्गे विमानवति ते भवने रमंते ॥ 7 ॥
4.129.m: Those men who incense even the best of gods with fragrant incenses of camphor and Turkish olibanum, / delightful with the finest scents resembling streams of camphor, rejoice in heaven in an abode possessing celestial chariots.

4.129.s:
dodhūyate kanakadaṃḍavirājitaiśca saccāmarairdhavalakuṇḍalasundarībhiḥ ..
divyāṃbarasraganulepanabhūṣi tāṅgāṃ kṛtvā sureśabhavanāṃbaravastrapūjām ..8..
4.129.d:
दोधूयते कनकदंडविराजितैश्च सच्चामरैर्धवलकुण्डलसुन्दरीभिः ॥
दिव्यांबरस्रगनुलेपनभूषि ताङ्गां कृत्वा सुरेशभवनांबरवस्त्रपूजाम् ॥8॥
4.129.m: [Such a one] is fanned with excellent chowries shining with golden sceptres by beautiful women with white earrings, / his body adorned with divine garments, garlands, and ointments, having performed worship with vestments and clothes in the temple of the lord of gods.

4.129.s:
dedīpyate dinakarojjvalapadmarāgaratnaprabhācchuritahemamaye vimāne ..
divyāṃganāparivṛto nayanābhirāmaḥ prajvālya dīpamamalaṃ bhavane surāṇām .. 9 ..
4.129.d:
देदीप्यते दिनकरोज्ज्वलपद्मरागरत्नप्रभाच्छुरितहेममये विमाने ॥
दिव्यांगनापरिवृतो नयनाभिरामः प्रज्वाल्य दीपममलं भवने सुराणाम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.129.m: Pleasing to the eye, surrounded by celestial women, he blazes in a golden celestial chariot overlaid with the radiance of rubies as dazzling as the sun, / having kindled a spotless lamp in the dwelling of the gods.

4.129.s:
yo jāgaraṃ suravarābhimato dadāti caitrotsavādidivaseṣvapi tūryanādaiḥ ..
vīṇāsuveṇumadhurasvarabhāṣi ṇībhiḥ saṃgīyate ca sa kṛśodarakinnarībhiḥ .. 4.129.10 ..
4.129.d:
यो जागरं सुरवराभिमतो ददाति चैत्रोत्सवादिदिवसेष्वपि तूर्यनादैः ॥
वीणासुवेणुमधुरस्वरभाषि णीभिः संगीयते च स कृशोदरकिन्नरीभिः ॥ 4.129.10 ॥
4.129.m: He who, favoured by the best of gods, offers a vigil with the sounds of musical instruments on occasions such as the spring festival, / is sung of by slender-waisted kinnarīs speaking with the sweet voices of lutes and flutes.

4.129.s:
kurvati ye sadupalenadhāturāgasaṃmārjanaṃ suravarāyatane'nuraktāḥ ..
muktākalāpamapi kāṃcanabhakti citrairvaiḍūryakṛṭṭimatale divi te vasaṃti .. 11 ..
4.129.d:
कुर्वति ये सदुपलेनधातुरागसंमार्जनं सुरवरायतनेऽनुरक्ताः ॥
मुक्ताकलापमपि कांचनभक्ति चित्रैर्वैडूर्यकृट्टिमतले दिवि ते वसंति ॥ 11 ॥
4.129.m: Those who, devoted to the temple of the foremost of gods, clean it with excellent stones and mineral colours, / dwell in heaven upon a mosaic floor of lapis lazuli adorned with strings of pearls and varied gold tracery.

4.129.s:
dadyācca yaḥ paramabhaktiyutaḥ surāṇāṃ ghaṇṭāvitānavaracāmaramātapatram ..
keyūrahāramaṇikuṇḍalabhūṣi tosau ratnādhipo vasati bhūtalacakravartī .. 12 ..
4.129.d:
दद्याच्च यः परमभक्तियुतः सुराणां घण्टावितानवरचामरमातपत्रम् ॥
केयूरहारमणिकुण्डलभूषि तोसौ रत्नाधिपो वसति भूतलचक्रवर्ती ॥ 12 ॥
4.129.m: And whoever, full of supreme devotion, gives the gods a bell, a canopy, an excellent chowrie, [or] a parasol, / adorned with armlets, necklaces, and jewelled earrings, lives as a sovereign lord of jewels, an emperor of the earth.

4.129.s:
abhyarcayetprativacaḥ kusumairvicitrairdevādhidevaparisaṃstutapādapadmān ..
bhaktyā prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ praṇamaṃti devāṃste bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahimāptaphalā bhavaṃti .. 13 ..
dīpadānavidhivarṇanam
4.129.d:
अभ्यर्चयेत्प्रतिवचः कुसुमैर्विचित्रैर्देवाधिदेवपरिसंस्तुतपादपद्मान् ॥
भक्त्या प्रहृष्टमनसः प्रणमंति देवांस्ते भूर्भुवः स्वर्महिमाप्तफला भवंति ॥ 13 ॥
दीपदानविधिवर्णनम्
4.129.m:
One should worship the lotus feet, extolled by the god of gods, with varied flowers according to each word; / those who bow down to the gods with devotion and delighted minds attain the fruit of greatness over earth, the intermediate region, and heaven.
